WHATEVER, WHATSOEVER: (1) yad yad, w. sin: yadyatpApam, Mah. i. 4.: v. Also soever.
WHATEVER , WHATSOEVER, pron. yatkiYcit, yadyad, yad, yAvat; ‘what- ever wealth is in the world,’ yatkiYcid or yAvad jagadvartti Danam asti.
WHEAL: I Mine: q. v.: KaniH.II Scar: kiRaH.
Wheat, s. goDUmaH, sumanaH. [Wheat]en, a. goDUmamaya, (s.) in comp.
WHEAT: goDUmaH (both the plant and grain).
WHEAT , s. goDUmaH, sumanAH m. (s), sumanaH, DAnyaM, pravawaH, rasAlaH, apUpaH, ganDavihvalaH, BUjambUH f., gorakzajambUH f., SitasUkaH, mlecCaBojanaH, sitaSi- mbikaH, nistuzakzIraH, bahudugDaH.
WHEATEN: (1) goDUma- in comp., w. powder: goDUmacUrRam;(2) goDUmamaya (f. yI).
WHEATEN , a. goDUmamayaH -yI -yaM, goDUmAtmakaH -kA -kaM, goDUma in comp.
Wheedle, v. t. cAwUktiBiH pra-tF c. or vaMc 10 or lal 10; See Flatter.
WHEEDLE: cAwuBirvipralaBate (laB, c. 1.): v. To coax, flatter.

Wheel, s. cakraM, raTAMgaM, maMqalaM. v. i. pariBram 1, 4 P, parA-pari-A-vft 1 A, maMqalAkAreRa Bram. v. t. vyAvft c., Bram c. [Wheel]ed, a. cakrin, cakrayukta. Wheel-wright, s. raTakAraH, cakrakAraH.
WHEEL (subs.): (1) cakram, two-w.ed carriage: dvicakraM yAnam; potter's w.: kulAlacakram;(2) raTANgam (poet.).
WHEEL (v.): I Trans.: Avartayati (c. of vft). II Intrans.: Avartate (vft, c. 1.): v. To roll, revolve, turn.
WHEEL , s. cakraM, raTANgaM, raTapAdaH, raTyaM, maRqalaM, upaDiH m., OpaDeyaM, naBiH m., dfmBUH f.; ‘its circumference,’ nemiH -mI, praDiH m., cakrapariDiH m.; ‘potter's wheel,’ kulAlacakraM.
To WHEEL , v. a. parivft (c. 10. -varttayati -yituM), vivft, Avft, vyAvft.
To WHEEL , v. n. parivft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), vivft, vyAvft, samparivft.
WHEEL-WRIGHT , s. raTakAraH, raTakft, raTakaraH, cakrakAraH.
WHEELBARROW: hastaNgamaM cakram (?) and sim. expr. s.
WHEELBARROW , s. hastasaYcAlitam ekacakrayuktaM vAhanaM.
WHEELED , a. cakravAn -vatI -vat (t), cakrI -kriRI -kri (n), cakrayuktaH -ktA -ktaM; ‘two-wheeled carriage,’ dvicakrayukto raTaH.
WHEELWRIGHT: cakrakAra (f. rI: (?); (2) raTa- kAra (f. rI).
Wheeze, v. i. kfcCreRa Svas 2 P.
WHEEZE: saSabdam or GozeRa Svasiti (Svas, c. 2.), Sr.
To WHEEZE , v. n. kAsaSvAsaM kf, kfcCreRa SvAsaM kf, pratikzutaM kf.
WHELK: SaNKaviSezaH.
Whelp, s. SAvaH-vakaH, SiSuH, kiSoraH.
WHELP: SAvaH-kaH, lion's w.: siMhaSAvaH; v. Young.
WHELP , s. SAvaH -vakaH, SiSuH m., vatsaH; ‘of a lion,’ siMhaSAvakaH.
When, adv. yadA; by loc. abs.; ‘w(hen) the speech was over’ vacasyavasite tasmin. 2 kadA; ‘w(hen)ever, (when)soever’ yadA yadA, yadA kadAcit. Whence, adv. yataH, yasmAt. 2 kutaH, kasmAt.

WHEN: I Rel.:(1) yadA, w. (she) saw no other source for acquiring him: yadA tasyADigame'nyaM viDiM nApaSyat, Ku.; w. I heard that Arjuna had won Draupadī: yadASrOzaM drOpadIM nirjitAmarjunena, Mah.;(2) by loc. absol. (when denoting sequence), w. Chandrāpīḍa said this: ityaBihita- vati candrApIqe, K.; w. the night had declined: avasannAyAM rAtrO, H.;(3) yarhi (rare).II Interro.:(1) kadA, w. did Paraśurāma conquer the heaven and the hell: kadA nu Kalu paraSurAmo rasAtalatridivayorjetA, B. r.; I donot know w.: na vedmi kadA..., Ku.
WHEN , adv. (At the time that) yadA, yarhi, or expressed by kAle, samaye, &c. in comp.; as, ‘when he was dying,’ maraRakAle. — (At what time?) kadA, karhi.
WHENCE: I Rel.:(1) yataH, w. you apprehend disregard: viSaNkase BIru yato'vaDIraRAm, Sa. iii. 16.;(2) yasmAt.II Interro.: kutaH, whence have you come: kuto BavAn, Mr. ii.;(2) kasmAt.

WHENCE , adv. (Interrog.) kutas, kasmAd deSAt &c., kasmAt sTA- nAt &c.; ‘whence have you come?’ kutaH samAgato'si. — (Indef.) yatas, yasmAd deSAt &c.; ‘to return whence one came,’ pratigantuM yaTAgataM.
WHENEVER, WHENSOEVER: (1) yadA yadA;(2) yadA kadAcit;(3) yarhi (rare).
WHENEVER , WHENSOEVER, adv. yadA yadA, yarhi yarhi, yadAkadAcit.

Where, adv. kva, kutra. 2 yatra; ‘w(her)ever’ yatra yatra; yatra kutrApi, yatra kutracit; ‘w(here)as’ yataH, viparyaye tu; ‘w(here)by’ yena; ‘w(here)fore’ yadarTaM, yataH, yena, kimarTaM, kasya hetoH; ‘w(here)in’, ‘w(here)to’ yatra; ‘w(here)upon’ yadanaMtaraM, tadanu.

WHERE: I Interro.:(1) kutra, w. did you get this: kutra tvayEtatsamAsAditam, Sa.;(2) kva, w. is that destroyer of the ten-headed: kAsO daSAsyAntakaH, Bho.II Relative: yatra, w. Rāma passed sometime: yatra rAmaH kaYcit kAlamuvAsa, K.
WHERE , adv. (In which place) yatra. — (In what place?) kutra, kva.
WHEREAS: (1) yataH;(2) yasmAt: v. Since.
WHEREAS , adv. yasmAt, yena, yatas. yat. See SINCE.
WHEREBY: I Relative: yena.II Interro.: kena.
WHEREBY , adv. (By which) yena. — (By what?) kena.
WHEREFORE: I Rel.: yadarTam.II Interro.: kimarTam: v. Why.
WHEREFORE , adv. (For which reason) yatas, yena, yat, yadarTaM, taTAtve. — (For what reason?) kimarTaM, kim, kena hetunA, kasya hetoH, kinnimittaM, kena nimittena.
WHEREIN: I Rel.: yatra.II Interro.: kutra.
WHEREIN , adv. (In which) yasmin, yatra. — (In what?) kasmin, kutra.
WHEREOF: I Rel.: yasya.II Interro.: kasya.
WHEREOF , adv. (Of which) yasya. — (Of what?) kasya.
WHERETO: I Rel.: yatra.II Interro.: kutra.
WHEREUPON: yadantaram (= after which); tadA (= then).
WHEREUPON , adv. yadanantaraM, yatrAntare, tadanantaraM, atrAntare.
WHEREVER: (1) yatra yatra;(2) yato yataH;(3) yatra kutracit (rare).
WHEREVER , WHERESOEVER, adv. yatra kutricit, yatra kutrApi, yatra yatra, kutrApi, kutracit, yatra kvacit.
WHERRY: kzudranOkAviSezaH.
WHERRY , s. daRqasaYcAlitA or kzepaRisaYcAlitA laGunOkA.
Whet, v. t. tij c., ni-, So 4 P, kzRu 2 P. [Whet]-stone, s. SARaH-RI, SARASman m.
WHET (v.): SARyati (nomi.), with an edge cleared by w.ting: SARena DOtaDArayA. N. xvi. 20.: v. To sharpen.
WHET (subs.): I W. stone: SARaH (RI).II Fig.: v. Stimulus.
To WHET , v. a. niSo, niSi, kzRu, tij. See To SHARPEN.
WHET-STONE , s. SARaH -RI, SAnaH, SARASma n. (n), BramaH, JAmaraH, vAgaraH, sAmakaH.
Whether, pron. kataraH-rA rat. conj. kiM followed by vA, uta, Aho or Ahosvit (for ‘or’), ‘w(hether) he do that or not’ sa tatkarotu na karotu vA.
WHETHER (pron.): kataraH (rA, t): v. Which (inter.).

WHETHER (conj.): they w. tigers or lions: te vyAGro vA siMho vA, S. iii. 2. 9.; it is doubtful w. the word prARa here refers to only air, or soul, or the supreme spirit: tatra saMSayaH kimiha prARaSabdena vAyumAtramamiDIyate, uta jIvaH, aTavA paraM brahme ti, S. 28.; w. it is the supreme spirit or something else: tat kiM paraM brahma syAdAhosvidarTAntaram, S. iii. 1.: v. Or.

WHETHER , adv. kiM, kiMvA, vA, uta. The particle vA, either with or without kiM, usually expresses the sense of ‘whether,’ as in the following examples; ‘whether you kill me or whether you release me,’ mAM mArayata vA muYcata vA; ‘do you know whether he is virtuous or not?’ vetsi kiM DArmmiko na vA; ‘whether or not he does that,’ tat karotu na karotu vA. — (Whether of twain, which of two) kataraH -rA -rat.
WHETSTONE: (1) SARaH (also -aSman etc.: v. Stone), (my) axe which has been whetted on the w. of enemies' heads: ripuSiraHSARaSAtaH kuWAraH, Vi. iii. 28.
Whey, s. mastu n., daDimaMqaM.
WHEY: (1) mastu (n.);(2) daDimaRqa (mn.).
WHEY , s. mastu n., daDimaRqaH -RqaM, dugDamaRqaM, daDyuttaraM.
Which, pron. (Relative) yat m. f. n. (yaH-yA-yat). 2 (Interrogative) kiM m. f. n. (kaH-kA-kiM); ‘w(hich) of two’ yatara, katara; ‘w(hich) of many’ yatama, katama; ‘w(hich)ever’ ex. by repeating (1).
WHICH (rel.): yat: v. Who, what. W. of two: yataraH (rA, t); w. of many: yatamaH (mA, -t).
WHICH (inter.): kim: v. Who, what; w. of two: kataraH (rA, -t); w. of many: katamaH (mA, -t).
WHICH , pron. (Relat.) yaH yA, yad, yO m. du., ye f. n. du., ye m. pl., yAH f. pl., yAni n. pl., see WHO. — (Interrog.) kaH kA kiM, kO m. du., ke f. n. du., ke m. pl., kAH f. pl., kAni n. pl.
WHICHEVER: yo yaH (yA yA, yad yat): v. Who- -ever, whatever.
WHICHEVER , pron. Expressed by doubling the relative, thus yad yad &c.
Whiff, s. PUtkAraH, PUtkftaM.
WHIFF: I Subs.: PutkAraH or Putkftam.II Verb: Putkaroti.
WHIFF , s. PutkftaM, PutkAraH, PUtkftaM, PUt indec. See PUFF.
WHIG: no equiv.: *vigaH.

While, s. kzaRaH, muhUrtaH, kAlaH, samayaH; ‘for a w(hile)’ kaMcitkAlaM, kzaRaM; ‘after a long w(hile)’ cireRa; ‘not worth w(hile)’ nizPala, nirarTaka, na upayukta; ‘worth w(hile)’ upayukta. conj. Whilst, yadA, yAvat (followed by tAvat); gen. by pres. part.; grAmaM gacCaMstfRaM spfSati ‘w(hile) going’ &c. v. t. (away) kzip 6 P, gam c., hf 1 P, vinud.
WHILE (subs.): for a little w.: kiyatkzaRam or kiYcitkAlam. After a long w.: cireRa: v. Time, moment. Ph.: not worth w.: nizPala (f. lA): v. Vain.
WHILE, WHILST (1) yadA: v. When; yAvat (as a conj.: with tAvat).
WHILE, -AWAY: gamayati (c. of gam): v. To pass.

WHILE , WHILST, adv. yAvat, yAvatkAlaM, yatkAlaM, yasmin kAle, yatparyyantaM, yadA; ‘whilst he thought on this the messenger arrived,’ yAvat tac cintayati dUtaH samAgacCati. The sense of whilst may sometimes be expressed by maDye, see DURING, or by the locative absolute, or some similar form of expression; as, sa tadeva cintayati dUtaSca samAgacCati.

WHILE , s. kAlaH, samayaH; ‘a long while,’ bahukAlaH; ‘for a long while,’ bahukAlaM, cirakAlaM, ciraM; ‘after a long while,’ cirAt; ‘a little while,’ alpakAlaH; ‘for a little while,’ alpakAlaM, kiYcitkAlaM; ‘in a little while,’ acireRa -rAt, kzaRAntare, kiyatA kAlena; ‘for a while,’ kiyatkAlaM, ApAtatas; ‘a long while ago,’ purA, pUrvvakAle; ‘one while,’ kadAcit. — (Worth while) saPalaH -lA -laM, PalavAn -vatI -vat (t), upayogI -ginI &c.
To WHILE , v. a. vinodena kAlaM gam (c. 10. gamayati -yituM) or nI (c. 1. nayati, netuM), vinud in caus. (nodayati -yituM).

Whim, s. kAmacAraH, kAmavftti f., CaMdaH, CaMdas n., cApalyaM, manolOlyaM, laharI, cittataraMgaH; ‘at oneʼs w(him)’ svacCaMdena, svecCayA; ‘acting according to anotherʼs w(him)’ CaMdonuvftti f. Whimsical, a. kAmacArin, svErin, svEra, svacCaMdAnuvartin, svacCaMda; capala, lola, anavasTita.
WHIM: kAmacAraH: v. Caprice, freak.
WHIM , s. manolOlyaM, cApalaM, cApalyaM. See FREAK, CAPRICE.
Whimper, v. i. bAlakavat rud 2 P or kraMd 1 P.
WHIMPER: cUMkaroti: v. To cry.
To WHIMPER , v. a. bAlakavat krand or rud or ru or kUj.
WHIMSICAL: (1) kAmacArin (f. RI);(2) caYcala (f. lA): v. Capricious, fickle.
WHIMSICAL , a. capalaH -lA -laM, lolaH &c., see CAPRICIOUS, FREAKISH.
To WHINE , v. n. kUj (c. 1. kUjati -jituM), anukUj. See To MURMUR.
WHINE , s. kUjanaM, kUjitaM, vilapanaM, kalarutaM, kAkuH f., kAkUktiH f.
WHINNY: (1) KiwaKiwAyitam (=murmur);(2) kranditam (= cry).
Whip, s. kaSA-zA, pratodaH, pratizkazaH-SaH. v. t. kaSayA pra-hf 1 P or taq 10 or cud 10 or daMq 10 or Ahan 2 U. [Whip]ping, s. kaSAGAtaH-tAqanaM-prahAraH; ‘deserving w(hipping)’ kaSya, kaSArha.
WHIP (subs.): (1) kaSA(zA) (also = w. ping), Si. v. 10.;(2) pratizkazaH (SaH: rare): v. Also scourge.
WHIP (v.): kaSayA hanti (han, c. 2.) or tAqayati (c. of taq); (2) kaSAGAtaM karoti.
To WHIP , v. a. kazayA or carmmarajvA or rajvA taq (c. 10. tAqayati -yituM) or daRq or SAs (c. 2. SAsti -situM). See To LASH.
WHIP , s. kaSA, kazA, carmmayazwiH f., pratizkazaH, BImA. See SCOURGE.
WHIPPED , p. p. kaSAhataH -tA -taM, daRqitaH &c.; ‘whipped horse,’ pratikaSASvaH.
WHIPPING , s. kaSAGAtaH, kapAGAtaH, kaSAtAqanaM, tAqanaM; ‘worthy of it,’ kaSyaH -SyA -SyaM, kaSArhaH -rhA -rhaM.

Whirl, v. i. GUrR 6 P, 1 A, pari-, Bram 1, 4 P. v. t. GUrR c., Bram c. (Bramayati). [Whirl]ing, s. BramaRaM, GUrRanaM, Brami f.; Avftti f.; ‘w(hirl)-pool’ AvartaH, BramiH, BramaH, jalAvartaH, jalagulmaH, ‘w(hirl)-wind’ cakravAtaH, vAtAvartaH; vAtyA, vAtaBramaH.
WHIRL: I Trans.: GUrRayati (c. of GUrR).II Intrans.: GUrRate (GUrR, c. 1.): v. To revolve.III Subs.: GUrRiH: v. Revolution.
To WHIRL , v. a. Bram (c. 10. Bramayati -yituM). See To TURN, TWIRL.
To WHIRL , v. n. Bram (c. 4. BrAmyati, c. 1, Bramati -mituM), atiSIGraM pari- vft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM) or GUrR. See To REVOLVE, v. n.
WHIRL , WHIRLING, s. BramaH -maRaM, BrAntiH f., BramiH f., viBramaH, AvfttiH f.
WHIRLED , p. p. BrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, udBrAntaH &c., SIGraM parivarttitaH &c.
WHIRLPOOL: (1) jalAvartaH;(2) BramiH (maH);(3) BramaraH, -kaH;(4) jalagulmaH;(5) avaGUrRaH;(6) AvartanI.
WHIRLPOOL , s. jalAvarttaH, jalaBramaH, jalagulmaH, AvarttaH -rttakA, AvarttinI, BfmiH m., BramaH, BramarakaH, avaGUrRaH. See EDDY.
WHIRLWIND: (1) cakravAtaH;(2) vAtAvartaH;(3) vAyugulmaH; etc.
WHIRLWIND , s. cakravAtaH, vAtAvarttaH, vAtamaRqalI, vAyugulmaH, vAtyA, BfmiH m., vAtaBramaH, AvarttaH, nirGAtaH, DrAjiH f., kunABiH m., pavAkA.
Whisk, v. t. atiSIGraM cal c. or vikzip 6 P. s. laGukzepaH. 2 cAmaraM (for flies).
WHISK: I Subs.: kUrcCam.II Verb: Aloqayati (c. of luq).
To WHISK , v. a. atikzipraM cal (c. 10. cAlayati -yituM), atilAGavena cal; ‘he whisks his tail,’ paripucCayati.
WHISK , s. laGukzepaH, AkasmikakzepaH. — (For flies, &c.) cAmaraM.
WHISKER: (1) gumPaH (?);(2) gumPaloman (n. (?).
WHISKER , s. pakzma n. (n), gumPaH, gaRqaloma n. (n), muKajaloma n.
Whiskers, s. gaMqaloman n., guMPaH.

sanskrit.slp1: nAnyena praseno hanyata ityaKila eva yadulokaH
sanskrit.word: नान्येन प्रसेनो हन्यत इत्यखिल एव यदुलोकः
sanskrit.iast: nānyena praseno hanyata ityakhila eva yadulokaḥ

details.body: Whisper, v. nIcEH-upAMSu-vad 1 P; karRe jap 1 P or kaT 10 or KyA 2 P; karRe upajap; ‘w(hisper) aside’ janAMtikaM vad. [Whisper]ing, s. karRevAdaH, upAMSuvAdaH, karRejapaH; japaH-panaM; ‘in a w(hispering)’ upAMSu, janAMtikaM, nIcasvareRa. [Whisper]er, s. karRe(rRa)japaH-kaTakaH.
WHISPER: (subs.): (1) expr. by verb.; (2) janaravaH (=rumour).

WHISPER: (v.): I Lit.:(1) karRamUle vadati (vad, c. 1.), V. p.;(2) karRAkarRi kaTayati (kaT, c. 10.), all the Yādavas w. ed among them- selves that Prasena was not murdered by any- body else: nAnyena praseno hanyata ityaKila eva yadulokaH karRAkarRyakaTayat, V.p.;(3) karRe japati (jap, c. 1.).

To WHISPER , v. n. jap (c. 1. japati -pituM), prajap, nIcasvareRa or nIca- vAcA vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM), nIcEr vad, upAMSu vad; ‘to whisper into the ear,’ karRam upajap, karRe kaT, karRe jap or vad; ‘to whisper to one's neighbour,’ janAntikaM vad.
WHISPER , WHISPERING, s. japaH -panaM, jApaH, karRejapanaM, karRekaTanaM, karRevAdaH, upAMSuvAdaH, upAMSukaTanaM, nIcErvAdaH; ‘in a whisper,’ upAMSu, janAntikaM.
WHISPERER , s. karRejapaH, karRajapaH, karRekaTakaH, karRopajApakaH.
WHIST: I Subs.: tAsakrIqAviSezaH.II Silent, silence: q. v.
Whistle, s. SISSabdaH. 2 vaMSaH-SI. v. t. SISSabdaM kf 8 U.
WHISTLE: SISayati (nomi.: (?); SISaM dadAti (dA, c. 3: (?).
WHISTLE (subs.): I W. ing: SISaH, -SabdaH (?): v. Also cry, noise.II An instrument: vaMSaH (?).
To WHISTLE , v. n. ozWADarasaNkocapUrvvaM SvAsotkzepaM kftvA SISSabdaM kf or sIsSabdaM kf or kIcakavat pawuSabdaMkf, veRuvat karkaSaSabdaM kf, ozWaSabdaM kf.
WHISTLE , s. (The sound) SISSabdaH, sIsSabdaH, ozWaSabdaH, kIcaka- SabdaH. — (Instrument for whistling) vaMSaH -SI, DvaninAlaH.
Whit, s. leSaH, lavaH, gaMDaH, aRuH; ‘not a w(hit)’ na manAgapi, na stokamapi, nAlpamapi.
WHIT: leSaH: v. Iota, Ph.: not a w.: na manAgapi; every w.: sarvaTA.
WHIT , s. leSaH, lavaH, lavaleSaH; ‘not a whit,’ na manAgapi.

White, a. Sukla, Sveta, Davala, SuBra, sita, gOra (rI f.), Suci, avadAta, viSada; DOta, pAMqura, avimala. s. SvetavarRaH, SuklavarRaH, SuklaH; SvetaH, sitaH, &c.; ‘dressed in w(hite)’ SvetavAMso daDAna. [Whit]en, v. t. DavalIkf 8 U, Davalayati (D.) &c. v. i. DavalIBU 1 P, DavalAyate (D.). [Whit]ish, a. ApAMqu. [White]ness, s. SuklatA, DAvalyaM, SuBratA, Davaliman, Sukliman m. White-wash, v. t. suDayA lip 6 P or DavalIkf; ‘a house w(hite-wash)ed’ suDABavanaM. s. suDA, suDAlepaH. Whites, s. SvetapradaraH.
WHITE (adj.): (1) Sukla (f. klA);(2) Sveta (f. tA);(3) Davala (f. lA);(4) sita (f. tA); (5) gOra (f. rI);(6) SuBra (f. BrA).
WHITE (subs.): I The colour:(1) SuklaH, -varRaH;(2) SvetaH, -varRaH, etc.II Of the eye: SvetaBAgaH, Bha. and sim. comp. s.

WHITE , a. SuklaH -klA -klaM, SvetaH -tA -taM, DavalaH -lA -laM, sitaH -tA -taM, SyetaH -tA -nI -taM, SuBraH -BrA -BraM, SuciH -ciH -ci, avadAtaH -tA -taM, viSadaH -dA -daM, gOraH -rI -raM, DOtaH -tA -taM, pARquraH -rA -raM, amalaH -lA -laM, vimalaH &c., rajataH -tA -taM, karkaH -rkA -rkaM, KaruH -ruH -ru, arjunaH -nI -naM, SitiH -tI -ti, arjunaCaviH -viH -vi, valakzaH -kzA -kzaM; ‘yellowish white,’ hariRaH -RA -RaM.
WHITE , s. (The colour) SuklaH, DavalaH, SvetaH, sitaH, valakzaH. — (Of the eye) SuklamaRqalaM, viYjamaraM.
WHITEBAIT: kzudramatsyaviSezaH.
WHITEN: I Trans.:(1) Davalayati (nomi.); (2) DavalIkaroti;(3) SuklIkaroti; etc. Intrans.: (1) DavalAyate (nomi.);(2) DavalIBavati;(3) SvetIBavati; etc.
To WHITEN , v. a. Sukla (nom. Suklayati -yituM), Davala (nom. Davalayati -yituM), SuklIkf, DavalIkf, AdIp (c. 10. -dIpayati -yituM).
To WHITEN , v. n. SuklIBU, DavalIBU, SvetIBU, viSadIBU.
WHITENED , p. p. DavalitaH -tA -taM, DavalIkftaH &c., SuklIkftaH -tA -taM.
WHITENESS: (1) SuklatA, tvam; DavalatA, -tvam, etc.; (2) SOklyam etc.;(3) Svetiman, Davaliman, sitiman (m.); etc.
WHITENESS , s. SuklatA -tvaM, SuklimA m. (n), SOklyaM, DavalatvaM -tA, DAvalyaM, SuBratA, SvetatA, sitatvaM, sitimA m. (n), vESadyaM.
WHITES , s. (Fluor albus) pradaraH, pradarAmayaH.
WHITEWASH: I Subs.: suDAlepaH.II Verb.: suDayA limpati, A-, vi- (lip, c. 6.).
WHITEWASH , s. suDA, SuklalepaH, DavalalepaH, DavalasuDA.
To WHITEWASH , v. a. suDayA lip (c. 6. limpati, leptuM) or Alip, suDayA DavalIkf or Davala (nom. Davalayati -yituM).
WHITEWASHED , p. p. suDADavalitaH -tA -taM, suDAliptaH &c.; ‘house,’ suDABavanaM.
Whither, adv. kutra, kva. 2 yatra.
WHITHER: I Interro.:(1) kva;(2) kutra.II Rel.: yatra.
WHITHER , adv. (Interrog.) kutra, kva; ‘whither shall I go?’ kva gacCAmi. — (Relat.) yatra.
WHITHERSOEVER , adv. yatra kutracit, yatra kutrApi.
WHITISH: (1) IzacCukla (f. klA);(2) ASveta (f. tA); etc.
WHITISH , a. IzacCuklaH -klA -klaM, IzatpARquH -RquH -Rqu, DUsaraH -rA -raM.
Whitlow, s. naKaMpacaH, cipyaM, naKavraRaM.
WHITLOW: (1) cippam;(2) naKaMpacaH.
WHITLOW , s. naKampacaH, cipyaM, kuRiH m., naKaSUlaH -laM, naKavraRaH.
WHITSUNTIDE, WHITSUNDAY: *SvetArkavAsaraH.
Whittle, v. t. Cid 7 U, takz 1 P.
WHIZ: SaRaSaRAyate (nomi. : (?).
To WHIZ , v. n. SISSabdaM kf, sIsSabdaM kf, raRaraRaSabdaM kf.

sanskrit.slp1: tasmin nagare vasati rAjA sa ca
sanskrit.word: तस्मिन् नगरे वसति राजा स च
sanskrit.iast: tasmin nagare vasati rājā sa ca

details.body: WHO: I Interro.: kim, w. is here: kaH ko'tra moH, U.; w. does not know Agastya: kaH punaragastyaM na jAnAti, B. r.; w. is this girl: keyaM kanyakA, K.II Rel.:(1) yad, I w. with two arms: yo'haM dAByAM BujAByAm, Vi. vi. ii.; whom the wise call resplendent lustre: predDaM DAma yadA- mananti suDiyaH, Vi. iv. 30. (G. § 145);(2) by bah. comp. (G. § 298).

WHO , pron. (Relat.) yaH yA yad, yO m. du., ye f. n. du., ye m. pl., yaH f. pl., yAni n. pl. The relative pronoun is not much used in Sanskrit excepting at the beginning of a sentence; as, ‘he who desires great riches is not wise,’ yo bahuDanam AkAMkzati sa budDihInaH. In other cases it is more usually expressed by sa ca or is inherent in a compound word or indecl. part.; thus, ‘in that city there dwelt a king who was beloved by his subjects,’ tasmin nagare vasati rAjA sa ca prajAvallaBaH; ‘a saint who has subdued his organs of sense,’ jitendriyo muniH; ‘by all the birds who had assembled,’ sarvvEH pakziBir militvA. — (Interrog.) kaH kA kiM, kO m. du., ke f. n. du., ke m. pl., kAH f. pl., kAni n. pl.; ‘who are you?’ kas tvaM; ‘who's there,’ ko'tra.
WHOEVER , WHOSOEVER, WHOSO, pron. yaH kaScit m., yA kAcit f., yatkiYcat n., yaH kopi m., yA kApi f., yatkimapi m., yo yaH m., yA yA f., yadyad n.

Whole, a. sakala, samagra, kftsna, aKila, samasta, sarva, aKaMqa, niKila, viSva, aSeza, niHSeza, pUrRa, anUna. 2 (Number) ABinna. s. sAkalyaM, kArtsnyaM, sAmagryaM, samAsaH; ‘on the w(hole)’ evaM ca, etAvatA, samAsataH, samAsena; ‘the w(hole) of’ ex. by (a.). [Whole]ly, adv. samagraM, sAkalyena, aSezeRa, niravaSezaM, sarvaTA, sarvataH-SaH, sarvaBAvena, ekAMtataH. Wholesale, a. Ex. by, stUpa in comp., samasta (vikrayaH); ‘w(holesale) dealer’ stUpavikrayin; ‘w(holesale) buying’ samastarASikrayaH.
WHOLE (adj.): (1) sakalaH (lA, laM), the w. mountain: sakalaH SElaH, Ki. xiii. 16.;(2) samagra (f. grA), the w. kingdom: samagraM rAjyam, K.;(3) kftsna (f. tsnA);(4) aKaRqa (f. RqA): v. Also entire.
WHOLE (subs.): (1) sAkalyam;(2) kArtsnyam; etc. Ph.: w. of = whole (adj.): q. v.: w. of the Rāmāyaṇa: samagraM rAmAyaRam.

WHOLE , a. sarvvaH -rvvA -rvvaM, sakalaH -lA -laM, samagraH -grA -graM, viSvaH -SvA -SvaM, kftsnaH -tsnA -tsnaM; ‘the whole earth,’ sarvvamahI; ‘the whole world,’ sarvvalokaH; ‘the whole night,’ sarvvarAtraH; ‘the whole day,’ sarvvAhlaH; ‘the whole business from beginning to end,’ sAdyantaM karmma, AgamanirgamO m. du.; ‘for the whole month,’ mAsaparyyantaM; ‘whole number,’ aBinnasaMKyA.
WHOLE , s. sAkalyaM, samudAyaH, kArtsnyaM, kArtsnaM, sAmagryaM, AKilyaM, mAtraM, samAsaH, samastaH -stiH f., vyastiH f.
WHOLENESS , s. sAmagryaM, sampUrRatA, aBinnatA. See ENTIRENESS.
WHOLESALE: w.-dealer: stUpavikrayin (f. RI: ?); w.-purchase: stUpakrayaH (?).
WHOLESALE , s. or a. samastavikrayaH, mahAvikrayaH, aKaRqavikrayaH.
Wholesome, a. paTya, ArogyAvaha, hitAvaha; See Salutary.

WHOLESOME: (1) paTya (f. TyA), is generally very w. for all animals: sarvaprARinAM sAmAnyataH paTyatamaH, Sr.;(2) hita (f. tA = good), abso- lutely w.: ekAntahita (f. tA), Sr.;(3) kzemya (f. myA= salutary: q. v.).
WHOLESOME , a. paTyaH -TyA -TyaM, hitaH -tA -taM. See SALUBRIOUS.
WHOLLY: (1) sAkalyena;(2) kArtsnyena;(3) samagram;(4) sampUrRam;(5) aSezeRa;(6) niravaSezam.
WHOLLY , adv. sarvvatas, sarvvaSas, sarvvaTA, sAkalyena, samyak, aSezatas, atyantaM, sarvvaBAvena, sarvvatoBAvena. See ENTIRELY.
Whoop, s. siMhanAdaH, kzveqA.
WHOOP: war w.: (1) siMhanAdaH;(2) kzveqA, -qitam.
WHOOP , s. (The cry) hUp; ‘war-whoop,’ siMhanAdaH, kzveqA -qitaM.
To WHOOP , v. n. hUpSabdaM kf, uccEHsvareRa kruS. See To SHOUT.
Whore, s. See Prostitute; ‘w(hore)ʼs son’ veSyAputraH; ‘w(hore)-monger’ BujaMgaH, viwaH [Whore]dom, s. veSyAvftti f. prasakti f.
WHORE: veSyA: v. Prostitute, harlot.
WHORE , s. veSyA, gaRikA, puMScalI, banDakI. See HARLOT.
WHOREDOM: (1) veSyAvfttiH and sim. comp. s. (of women);(2) veSyAprasaktiH and sim. comp. s. (of men), to commit w.: veSyAM BuMkte Bajate, sevate, etc.
WHOREMONGER: (1) veSyAgAmin (m.);(2) BujaNgaH;(3) viwaH;(4) gamyaH (rare), “hftaSizwAnAM gamyaDanAnAM citrErupAyErapaharaRam,” D. ii.
WHORESON: veSyAputraH and sim. comp. s.
WHORESON , s. veSyAputraH, gaRikAputraH, puMScalIjaH.

WHOSE , pron. (Relat.) yasya m., yasyAH f. The relative ‘whose’ is not often expressed in Sanskrit, but is frequently in- herent in a compound, or rendered by tasya ca &c., see WHO; as, ‘a wife whose husband is abroad,’ prozitaBarttfkA strI. — (Interrog.) kasya m., kasyAH f.

WHOSOEVER: (1) yo yaH (yA yA, yadyat), at whom- soever lady the beloved (Kṛṣṇa) looked: yAM yAM priyaH prEkzata, Si. iii. 16.;(2) yaH kaScit or kaScana (yA kAcit or -cana, yatkiYcit or -cana) (= any one w. G. 301).
Why, adv. kiM, kutaH, kasmAt, kimarTaM, kinnimittaM, kena hetunA; ‘w(hy) do you do so’ evaM karaRe kastava hetuH. 2 nanu; ‘w(hy) you yourself are before me’ nanu BavAneva mamAgre vartate (S. 2).

WHY (adv.): (1) kim (not absol.), w. are you thus tiring yourself for nothing: vyarTa pariSrAmyasi vA kimitTam, N. iii. 13;(2) kutaH or kasmAt, w. because the word soul (is used): kasmAt Atma- SabdAt, S.;(3) kimarTam (= for what object); (4) kinnimittam;(5) kiMkAraRam, kena hetunA, kasmAdDetoH, etc. (= for what reason).
WHY (interj.): w. what have I done: kiM nAma mayA kftam; w. yes I say so: vAQaM bravImyevam.

WHY , adv. kimarTaM, kiM, kena hetunA, kinnimittaM, kasya hetoH, see WHERE- FORE; ‘why inquire into my story?’ kiM te mama vfttAntapraSnena; ‘why conceal it?’ saMvaraRe kiM kAraRaM; ‘why do you do this?’ kimarTaM tat karozi.
Wick, s. daSA, varti f., vartikA, tElinI.
WICK: (1) daSA;(2) vartiH, -kA;(3) piYjalam; (4) tElinI.
WICK , s. (Of a lamp, &c.) tUlA -lI, varttiH f., varttikA, tElinI, tElamAlI, daSA, daSAkarpaH, piYjUlaM, dIpakUpI, dIpaKorI.

Wicked, a. (Of persons) duzwa, durjAta, durAtman, pApa, SaWa, durAcAra, Kala, pApakarman, durvftta, nfSaMsa, pApAtman, pApacarita, aDArmika (kI f.), duScaritra. 2 (Of things) duzwa, pApa in comp., dur pr.; ‘w(icked) policy’ durRItiH; See Sinful. [Wicked]ly, adv. duzwatayA, durvfttatayA, Kalavat. [Wicked]ness, s. duzwatA, dOrjanyaM, dOrAtmyaM, pApaM, duzkftaM-ti f., pApakarman n., durAcAraH, anAcAraH.

WICKED: I Of men:(1) duzwa (f. zwA);(2) durvftta (f. ttA);(3) durAtman (mfn.);(3) pApa- karman (mfn.);(5) pAmara (f. rA);(6) Kala (f. lA);(7) pApamati (mfn.) and sim. comp. s. II Of acts:(1) duzwa (f. zwA);(2) pApa- in comp.

WICKED , a. (Said of persons) duzwaH -zwA -zwaM, pApI -pinI -pi (n), durvfttaH -ttA -ttaM, durAtmA -tmA -tma (n), pApAtmA &c., apuRyaH -RyA -RyaM, SaWaH -WA -WaM, pAmaraH -rA -raM, KalaH -lA -laM, nEkftikaH -kI -kaM, nEzkftikaH &c., aDArmmikaH -kI -kaM, duzwamAnasaH -sA -saM, duScaritraH -trA -traM, vikarmmikaH &c., see SINFUL; ‘a wicked man,’ durjanaH, asajjanaH. — (Of actions) duzwaH -zwA -zwaM, pApa in comp., see SINFUL; [Page841-a+ 51] ‘a wicked act,’ pApakarmma n. (n); ‘very wicked,’ pApizWaH -zWA -zWaM, durizWaH &c.
WICKEDLY: (1) duzwatayA;(2) durvfttatayA;(3) durAcAratayA; etc.
WICKEDLY , adv. duzwaM, duzwavat, sapApaM, durjanavat, durvfttavat, Kalavat.
WICKEDNESS: (1) duzwatA;(2) durvfttatA;(3) durAcAratA, etc.

WICKEDNESS , s. pApaM, duzkftaM, duzkftiH f., kukarmma n. (n), duzkarmma n., kukftyaM, kusftiH f., nikftiH f., nikAraH, duzwatA, dOzWavaM, dOrAtmyaM, dOrjanyaM, durjanatvaM, asADutA, viprakAraH, kOkftyaM, asatkarmma n., see SIN- FULNESS; ‘great wickedness,’ pApizWatA, pApIyastvaM, durizWaM.
Wicker, a. vERava (vI f.), vEdala (lI f.); ‘w(icker)-work’ vEdalaM.
WICKER: (1) vEdala (f. lI);(2) vERava (f. vI), w.-work: vEdalam.
WICKER , a. vEdalaH -lI -laM, vERavaH -vI -vaM, vERukeyaH -yI -yaM, vEtrakaH -kI -kaM, vaMSAdidalanirmmitaH -tA -taM; ‘wicker-work,’ vEdalaM.
WICKET , s. kzudradvAraM, upadvAraM, dvArakaM, KaqakkikA.

Wide, a. vistIrRa, viSAla, uru, vipula, pfTu; See Broad; ‘w(ide) of the mark’ lakzyaBrazwa-cyuta, aprAstAvika (kI f.). [Wide]ly, adv. vipulaM, sarvatra, su-ati-bahu pr., ‘w(idely) known’ suviKyAta, ‘w(idely) awake’ suprabudDa; ‘with eyes w(idely) open’ utPullanayana. [Wid]en, v. t. pfTUkf 8 U, viSAlIkf, praT 10. Width, s. vistAraH, vyAsaH, pariRAhaH, viSAlatA.
WIDE: (1) vistIrRa (f. rRA);(2) viSAla (f. lA);(3) vipula (f. lA).
WIDE, WIDELY: (1) vistIrRam;(2) viSAlam; (3) vipulam. Ph.: w. awake: suprabudDa (f. dDA); w. open: suvivfta (f. tA); w. -spread: bahuvistIrRa (f. rRA); etc.

WIDE , a. viSAlaH -lA -laM, pfTuH -TuH -Tu, vistIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, vipulaH -lA -laM, viprakfzwaH -zwA -zwaM; ‘wide-spread,’ bahuvistIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, santataH -tA -taM, bahupratAnI &c.; ‘wide-awake,’ prabudDaH -dDA -dDaM; ‘wide-mouthed,’ guhAmuKaH -KA -KaM; ‘wide-open,’ utPullaH -llA -llaM.
WIDE , WIDELY, adv. vistIrRaM, vistareRa, vipulaM, pracuraM, atyantaM, bahu or ati or su prefixed, see EXTENSIVELY.
WIDEN: (1) viSAlIkaroti;(2) pfTUkaroti;(3) by adj.
To WIDEN , v. a. praT (c. 10. praTayati -yituM), pfTUkf, viSAlIkf.
WIDENESS: (1) vistIrRatA;(2) viSAlatA;(3) pfTutA.
WIDENESS , s. viSAlatA, pfTutA, vistftiH f. See BROADNESS.
Widow, s. viDavA, a-gata-BartfkA, viSvastA, anATA, raMqA; ‘child-w(idow)’ bAlaviDavA. [Widow]ed, a. anATA, nazwaBartfkA. [Widow]er, s. mftapatnIkaH, gataBAryaH. [Widow]hood, s. vEDavyaM, vEDavyadaSA.
WIDOW: (1) viDavA;(2) gataBartfkA;(3) raRqA (specially as a term of abuse). A w. before puberty: bAlaviDavA; a childless w.: avIrA, A.
WIDOW (v.): viDavAM karoti. W. ed: (1) anATaH (TA, TaM);(2) gataBartfka (f. kA) and sim. comp. s. Un-w.ed lady: aviDavA, Me. ii. 38.

WIDOW , s. viDavA, raRqA, viSvastA, viSvasTA, gataBarttfkA, mftapatikA, aBarttfkA, nirnATA, anATA, avIrA, yatinI, vfpaBI, kAtyAyanI, vitantuH f.; ‘widow before puberty,’ vAlaviDavA, bAlaraRqA; ‘widow that burns with the body of her husband,’ satI; ‘the act of doing so,’ agnipraveSaH, sahamaraRaM, sahagamanaM, anugamanaM, anvArohaRaM; ‘stone by which she ascends the pyre,’ DarmmaSilA.
WIDOWED , a. hftaBarttfkA, hftapatikA. — (Stripped) hftaH -tA -taM.
WIDOWER: (1) mftaBAryaH, P. iv. 9.;(2) mftapatnIkaH, and sim. comp. s.
WIDOWER , s. mftaBAryyaH, mftapatnIkaH, viDuraH, ayogaH.
WIDOWHOOD: vEDavyam, burning with w.: vEDavyatA- pitaH (tA, taM), Ki. xi. 6.
WIDOWHOOD , s. vEDavyaM, vEDavyadaSA, viDavAtvaM, nirnATatA, raRqAvasTA, CatraBaNgaH.
WIDTH: (1) vistAraH;(2) vyAsaH;(3) pariRAhaH: v. Breadth.
WIDTH , s. viSAlatA, pariRAhaH, vyAsaH, parisaraH. See BREADTH.
Wield, v. t. (hastena) Bf 3 U, Df 1 P, 10, pra-upa-yuj 7 A, 10. 2 (A state &c.), pra-, SAs 2 P, nirvah c.; rAjyaDurAM vah 1 P. [Wield]y, a. suprayojya; (body) utTAnayogya (S. 2).
WIELD: (1) viBarti (Bf, c. 3. = hold);(2) praRayati (nI, c. 1. = manage).
To WIELD , v. a. hastena Df (c. 1. Darati, c. 10. DArayati -yituM) or DA (c. 3. daDAti, DAtuM) or viDA, hastena Bf (c. 1. Barati, c. 3. biBartti, BarttuM), hastena prayuj or upayuj or praRI.

Wife, s. BAryA, patnI, jAyA, vaDUH, kalatraM, dAra m. (pl.), strI, parigrahaH, gfhiRI, gehinI, sahaDarmiRI, dayitA, vallaBA, priyA, kAMtA, ramaRI, kzetraM, gfhAH (pl.); ‘a rival w(ife)’ sapatnI; ‘taking a w(ife)’ dAraparigrahaH-kriyA; ‘a w(ife) whose husband has gone abroad’ prozitaBartfkA.

WIFE: (1) BAryA;(2) jAyA;(3) patnI;(4) dArAH (only in m. pl.);(5) strI;(6) vaDUH;(7) kalatram;(8) sahaDarmiRI (not used absol.);(9) parigrahaH (rare), although I have many wives: pari- grahabahutve'pi, Sa. A rival w.: sapatnI. Taking a w.: dAraparigrahaH. To supersede a w.: aDivindati (vid, c. 6.), R. W. of a teacher: upADyAyI; w. of a spiritual guide: AcAryAnI; w. of Indra: indrARI.

WIFE , s. BAryyA, strI, patnI, jAyA, dArAH m. pl., dArA, vaDUH f., baDUH f., kalatraM, gfhiRI, gehinI, pARigfhItA, sahaDarmmiRI, saDarmmiRI, dayitA, kAntA, vallaBA, priyA, priyatamA, ramaRI, nAyikA, prAReSA, prARasamA, preyasI, prezWA, vanitA, dvitIyA, mahilA, kzetraM, parigrahaH, gfhaM, gfhAH m. pl., DUtA, ardDANgaM, vAmANgaM, dam indec.; ‘virtuous and faithful wife,’ pativratA, satI, sADvI, suvratA, DarmmadArAH m. pl., patiprARA, sucaritrA; ‘one who has a family,’ kuwumbinI, puranDriH -nDrI; ‘a super- seded wife,’ aDyUQA, aDivinnA, kftasApatnikA -tnIkA, kftasApatnI, kftasApatnakA, kftasapatnikA; ‘wife of one husband,’ ekaBarttfkA; ‘rival wife,’ sapatnI; ‘one's own wife,’ svakIyA, svIyA; ‘wife of another,’ parakIyA, parastrI, paradArAH m. pl.; ‘well-born wife,’ kulastrI; ‘wife of one's bosom,’ vakzaHsammardinI; ‘un- faithful wife,’ apativratA, asatI; ‘taking a wife,’ dAraparigrahaH, dArasaMgrahaH, dArakriyA; ‘along with one's wife, or having a wife,’ savaDUkaH, sapatnIkaH, saBAryyaH; ‘condition of a wife,’ BAryyAtvaM, patnItvaM; ‘one whose husband is abroad,’ prozitaBarttfkA; ‘wife's property,’ strIDanaM.
Wig, s. upakeSaH, kftrimakeSaH. v. t. nir-Barts 10 A, upAlaB 1 A.
WIG: *kESikam.
WIG , s. upakeSaH, kftrimakeSaH, keSamayamastakABaraRaM.
Wight, s. mARavakaH, jaMtuH, prARin m.
WIGHT: mARavakaH: v. Person.
WIGHT , s. janaH, mARavakaH, nAgaraH; ‘unlucky wight,’ tapasvI m. (n).

Wild, a. vanya, vanajAta, AraRyaka, vana-araRya in comp.; ‘a w(ild) mountain’ kAMtAramaDyavartI-vanAMtargataH-parvataH; vanapaSuH, vanagajaH, vanapuzpaM &c. 2 hiMsra, krUra, kravyAd. 3 unmatta, ativyAkula; ‘w(ild) with anger’ kroDonmatta; ‘w(ild) with joy’ harzonmatta, harzanirBara. 4 pracaMqa, tIvra; durdAMta, aniyaMtraRa, uddAmavftti, ucCfMKala; ‘w(ild)-storm’ pracaMqaprakaMpanaH. 5 ayuktika, anupapanna, nirarTaka; See Absurd. [Wild]erness, s. vanaM, araRyaM; See Forest. 2 maruH, -BUmi f., Danvan m. [Wild]ly, adv. unmattavat, pracaMqaM, sonmAdaM, ucCfMKalaM. [Wild]ness, s. vanyatA, rOdratA, unmAdaH, &c.

WILD: I Lit.:(1) by comp., by w. plants: vanalatABiH, Sa.; w. mountain scenery: araRya- giriBUmiH, Vi.;(2) vanya (f. nyA), w. instru- ment of sustenance: vanyaM sTitisADanam, R. v. 9.; (3) AraRya (f. RyA), -ka (f. kA), w. animal: AraRyo mfgaH, M. v. 9.;(4) vanajAta (f. tA) and sim. comp.s; w. animal: vanajaM sattvam, Ki. xiii. 8; marshy and w.: anUpotTaM vanotTaM ca, Mat. 117. 45.II Fig.: v. Savage, rude.III Violent, unrestrained: q. v.: durdAnta (f. ntA). IV Bewildered, mad: q. v.
WILD, WILDERNESS (subs.): I Forest, wood: q. v.: vanam.II Desert: q. v.: maruH, -BUmiH.

WILD , a. (Pertaining to or inhabiting a forest or wilderness, [Page841-b+ 51] not tame) AraRyaH -RyI -RyaM, AraRyakaH -kA -kaM, vanyaH -nyA -nyaM, araRyajaH -jA -jaM, vanajaH &c., AraRIyaH -yA -yaM, jaNgalaH -lA -laM, jANgalaH -lI -laM, vanecaraH -rA -raM, vanacArI -riRI -ri (n), vana in comp., araRya in comp., see DESERT, a.; ‘wild-animal, wild- beast,’ araRyapaSuH m., vanapaSuH m., AraRyapaSuH m.; ‘wild hog,’ araRyaSUkaraH, AraRyaSUkaraH, vanaSUkaraH; ‘wild goat,’ vanaCAgaH; ‘wild elephant,’ vanagajaH; ‘wild fowl,’ vanakukkuwaH, vfkzakukkuwaH, rajjudA- lakaH; ‘wild duck,’ kAmikaH; ‘wild stag,’ araRyamfgaH, vyAlamfgaH. — (Growing without culture) araRya in comp., vana in comp.; ‘wild flower,’ vanapuzpaM; ‘wild fruit,’ vanaPalaM; ‘wild rice,’ araRyaDAnyaM, tfRaDAnyaM, nIhAraH. — (Irregular, disorderly) vizamaH -mA -maM, ucCfNKalaH -lA -laM, prakIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, see IRREGULAR. — (Absurd) ayuktikaH -kA -kaM, anarTakaH -kA -kaM. — (Mad) unmattaH -ttA -ttaM. — (Savage, desert), see the words.
WILD-GOOSE-CHASE , s. mfgatfzRA, hemamfgAnugamanaM, hemamfgAnuDAvanaM.
WILDERNESS , WILD, s. araRyaM, vanaM, jaNgalaM, SUnyAraRyaM, marudeSaH, marusTalaM, maruH m., jANgalaBUmiH f., prAntaraM. See DESERT, s.
WILDLY: (1) unmattavat (=madly);(2) vyAkulam (= bewildered);(3) caRqam (= violently).
WILDLY , adv. vizamaM, ucCfNKalaM, unmattavat, sonmAdaM, vyAkulaM.
WILDNESS: I Lit.:(1) vanyatA;(2) better by adj.II Irregularity: q. v.: ucCfNKalatA, tvam.III Savageness, ferocity: q. v.:IV Alienation: viBramaH.
WILDNESS , s. (Uncultivated state) vanyatA, AraRyatA, jaNgalatvaM.- (Savageness) rOdratA, dAruRatA, aSizwatA. — (Irregularity) viza- matA, ucCfNKalatA. — (Madness) unmattatA, vikziptatA.
Wile, s. CalaM, kapawaM, vaMcanaM, mAyA, Cadman n. Wily, a. BUrimAya, mAyAvin, samAya, Cadmapara, kApawika-CAdmika- (kI f.), sakapawa.
WILE: Calam: v. Trick, pretext, deceit.
WILE , s. mAyA, CalaM, Cadma n. (n), kapawaH -waM, upAyaH, vyapadeSaH.
WILFUL: I In good sense:(1) by adv.; (2) kAmataH kfta (f. tA); etc.II Perverse, headstrong:(1) svErin (f. RI);(2) svecCA- cArin (f. RI); etc.
WILFUL , a. svErI -riRI -ri (n). See WILLFUL.
WILFULLY: (1) kAmataH;(2) kAmAt;(3) icCA- pUrvakam etc.
WILFULLY , adv. yaTAkAmaM, yaTezwaM, svEravat, yadfcCayA, icCAtas, kAmaM.
WILFULNESS: I Voluntariness: expr. by adv.II Obstinacy:(1) kAmacAraH, kAmacAritA; (2) svecCAcAritA; etc.
WILFULNESS , s. svEritA, svEratA, svEraM, svecCA, svecCAcAraH, yaTezwacAraH, svAtantryaM, svatantratA, yadfcCA, prAkAmyaM. See SELF-WILL.
WILILY: (1) Calena;(2) mAyayA;(3) CadmanA;(4) sakapawam, etc.

Will, v. saMkxp c., nirdiS 6 P, niSci 5 U, nirRI 1 P. 2 Wish, q. v. 3 (As auxiliary) by Future or Pot. mood. s. saMkalpaH, saMkalpa-icCA-Sakti f. 2 kAmaH, icCA, aBilAzaH, AkAMkzA, izwaM; ‘Godʼs w(ill) be done’ ISvarecCA balIyasI, praBavati BagavAn viDiH; ‘against oneʼs w(ill)’ balAt, haWAt, akAmataH; ‘would have her w(ill)’ AtmABiprAye nirbaMDaparAsIt; ‘at w(ill)’ svecCayA, yaTAkAmaM, svEraM, kAma in comp.; ‘subject to the w(ill) of another’ parataMtravaSa. 3 icCApatraM. [Will]ful, a. kAmataH kfta. 2 svErin, kAma-svecCA-cArin, svEravfttagAmin, See Wanton. [Will]fully, adv. kAmataH, icCApUrvakaM, svEraM, budDyA, jAnat a. api. [Will]fulness, s. kAmacAraH, svecCAcAraH, yadfcCA, svEritA, svAcCaMdyaM. [Will]ing, a. icCu, sakAma, udyata; oft. by desid. 2 izwa, anumata, yaTepsita. [Will]ingly, adv. prakAmaM, svecCayA, kAmataH, svecCApUrvaM. Would, (that) Ex. by api nAma; api nAmAhamapyAtmanonurUpaM varaM laBeyeti (S. 1); ‘w(ould) I had loved him more’ varaM tasminnahamaDikataraM snigDo'BUvaM; yadi … aBavizyaM tarhi-aho SoBanamApatizyat.

WILL (v.): I To resolve, determine: q. v.: (1) saMkalpayati (kxpa, c. 10.);(2) saMkalpaM karoti. II To direct, order: q. v.: nirdiSati (diSa, c. 6.).III To devise by will: *icCApatreRa dadAti (dA, c. 3.).IV Denoting future: expr. by xw or luw (Vide Grammar).
WILL (subs.): I Volition: saMkalpaH.II De- -sire, wish: q. v.: kAmaH, against one's will: akAmataH, M.III Testament: *icCApatram.

WILL , s. (Faculty which is exercised in deciding) icCA, saNkalpa- SaktiH f., niScayaSaktiH f. — (Inclination, choice, liking) icCA, saNkalpaH, vaSaH -SaM, aBiprAyaH, aBilAzaH, AkAMkzA, aBipretaM, aBimataM, izwaM, Candas n.; ‘the will of God,’ parameSvarecCA; ‘of one's own will, at will,’ icCAtas, svecCAtas, svecCAnusAreRa, yaTAkAmaM, kAmatas; ‘ill-will,’ duzwaBAvaH, duzwabudDiH f.; ‘good will,’ hitecCA, hitakAmyA; ‘subject to the will of another,’ paravaSaH -SA -SaM; ‘following one's own will,’ svecCAcArI -riRI -ri (n), see WILFUL; ‘against the will of,’ anicCayA, anicCAtas, anaBipretena. — (Testament) mftapatraM, mftyupatraM, mftaleKaH, mftyuleKaH. — (Will-with-a wisp), see IGNIS FATUUS.

To WILL , v. a. (Determine, decide in the mind) saNkalpaM kf, ni- ScayaM kf, niSci, nirRI, saMkxp (c. 10. -kalpayati -yituM), manasA niSci or nirRayaM kf. — (Wish, desire) iz (c. 6. icCati, ezituM), aBilaz, AkAMkz. — (Command), see To COMMAND. — (Dispose of by testament) mftapatreRa dA or pradA or f in caus.
WILLED , p. p. saNkalpitaH -tA -taM, sANkalpikaH -kI -kaM, izwaH -zwA -zwaM.

WILLFUL , a. svErI -riRI -ri (n), yaTezwacArI &c., yaTAkAmI &c., svEraH -rI -raM, svEravfttaH -ttA -ttaM, svEragatiH -tiH -ti, svEragAmI -minI &c., yAdfcCikaH -kI -kaM, CAndasaH -sI -saM. See SELF-WILLED.
WILLING: I Desirous, consenting:(1) icCu, (mfn.), -ka (f. kA);(2) sakAma (f. mA), a w. woman: sakAmA strI.II Chosen, desired: izwa (f. zwA), aBi-.

WILLING , a. (Not averse, ready) icCuH -cCuH -cCu, icCukaH -kA -kaM, sakAmaH -mA -maM, sAnurAgaH -gA -gaM. — (Received of choice, as- sented to) izwaH -zwA -zwaM, yaTezwaH &c., aBIzwaH &c., anumataH -tA -taM, sammataH &c., yaTepsitaH &c.
WILLINGLY: (1) sAgraham (= zealously);(2) sAnurAgam (= ardently).
WILLINGLY , adv. kAmaM, prakAmaM, kAmatas, icCAtas, yaTepsitaM, taTeti
WILLINGNESS , s. sakAmatvaM, icCutA, icCukatvaM, sAnurAgatA, sammatiH f.
WILLOW: vfkzaviSezaH.
Wilt, v. i. mlE 1 P, glE 1 P.
WILY: (1) bahucCala (f. lA);(2) kapawapriya (f. yA); (3) catura (f. rA = artful).
WILY , a. mAyI -yinI -yi (n), bahumAyaH -yA -yaM. See CUNNING.

Win, v. t. vi-ji 1 A, vijayin a. BU; ‘won the battle’ yudDe jayamApa, samaravijayI baBUva; ‘who is said to w(in)’ yo vijayIti gaRyate-manyate. 2 laB 1 A, prAp 5 P; See Get. 3 Akfz 1 P, pra-vi-luB c.; See Attract; ‘w(in) over’ svapakzaM grah c., anuyAyin a. kf. [Win]ner, s. jayin m., jetf m. [Win]ning, s. jayaH. 2 lABaH, arjitaM. [Win]some, a. hfdayahArin, cittAkarzin.

WIN: I In a contest: jayati, vijayate (ji, c. 1.), I have won: jitam, Mah. ii. 61. 27.; I won (the case) first: jita eva mayAyaM prAk, Mit. II To gain, get: q. v.: laBate (laB, (c. 1.), what is won in a controversy: yadvAdAllabDaM, vivAde yannistIrya labDam, Da. 93.

To WIN , v. a. (Gain by conquest) ji (c. 1. jayati, jetuM), nirji, pratiji. — (Gain, obtain) arj, prAp, laB, see To OBTAIN. — (Win over) ArAD (c. 10. -rADayati -yituM), anuraYj, prasAD, saMgrah, see To CONCILIATE.
Wince, v. i. vi-, kaMp 1 A, sPur 6 P, ‘he did not w(ince)’ sa Bayacakito nABavat; See Start.
To WINCE , v. n. vikamp (c. 1. -kampate -mpituM), visPur (c. 6. -sPurati -rituM).
WINCH: perh. daRqaH.

Wind, s. vAtaH, vAyuH, pavanaH, pavamAnaH, anilaH, samIraRaH, mArutaH, marut m., mAtariSvan, SvasanaH, sparSanaH, gaMDava(vA)haH, ASugaH. 2 (In stomach) vAtaH; vAyuH. 3 SvAsaH; ‘w(ind)fall’ vAyupAtaH; (fig.) alaByalABaH; ‘w(ind)lass’ uttolanI; ‘w(ind)mill’ vAyucAlyaM cakraM, vAyupezaRI. v. i. vakraM-kuwilaM-gam or sfp 1 P, jihmaM yA 2 P; ‘the river runs w(ind)ing for a koss’ kroSaM kuwilA nadI (S. K.). 2 Turn, q. v. v. t. pari-A-vft c. 2 pUr 10 (mArutena), DmA 1 P. 2 (Up) saMpuwIkf 8 U, piMqIkf, upa-, saM-hf 1 P; ava-so 4 P; (hair) saM-hf, saM-yam c., (saMyamaya keSapASaM Ka. 84). [Wind]ing, a. vakra, kuwila, jihma. s. vakraM, vaMkaH, puwaBedaH. [Wind]ward, adv. vAtABimuKaM. [Wind]y, a. vAtamaya (yI f.). vAtula. Window, s. vAtAyanaM, jAlaM, gavAkzaH.

WIND (subs.): I Lit.:(1) vAyuH, with favour- able w.: anukUlena vAyunA, Mah. i. 148. 20.; (2) vAtaH, head w.: prativAtaH, D. vi.;(3) pavanaH, gentle w.: mfdupavanaH, V. iv.;(4) anilaH, w. footed: anilaraMhas, (mfn.), Mah.;(5) samIraH, -RaH;(6) marut;(7) mArutaH.II Of stomach: [Page763] vAyuH.III Flatulence: q. v.IV Breath: SvAsaH.
WIND (v. i.): I To bend: vakraM or kuwilaM gacCati (gam, c. 1.) or sarpati (sfp, c. 1.), w. ing: v. Crooked.II To turn: q. v.: Avartate (vft, c. 1.).
WIND (v. t.): I To turn, twine: Avartayati (c. of vft).II To blow: q. v.: pUrayati (pUr, c. 10.).

WIND , s. (Air in motion) vAyuH m., anilaH, vAtaH, pavanaH, marut m., marutaH, mArutaH, vAtiH f., samIraRaH, samIraH, samiraH, sadAgatiH m., satatagatiH m., ASugaH, pavamAnaH, praBaYjanaH, ganDavahaH, ganDavAhaH, praDA- vanaH, DavARakaH, jagatprARaH, jagadvalaH, SvasanaH, sparSanaH, mAtariSvA m. (n), pfzadaSvaH, pfzatASvaH, pfzatAmpatiH m., prajInaH, atasaH, tAndanaH, laGawiH m., viSvayuH m., yaH. — (Air) vAyuH m., sparSaH; ‘against the wind,’ prativAtaM; ‘cold wind,’ himAnilaH; ‘swift as the wind,’ vAyuvegasamaH -mA -maM, vAyugatiH -tiH -ti; ‘like the wind,’ vAyusamaH -mA -maM, vAyuBUtaH -tA -taM. — (Flatulence) vAyuH m., vAtaH, see FLATULENCE; ‘to break wind,’ pard (c. 1. pardate -rdituM), SfD (c. 10. SarDayati -yituM).

To WIND , v. a. (Blow a horn, &c.) SaNKaM DmA. — (Cause to turn or twist) Avft (c. 10. -varttayati -yituM), parivft, see To TWIST, v. a. — (Wind up, as a discourse, &c.) upasaMhf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), pratyAhf, upasaMhAraM kf, pratyAhAraM kf.
To WIND , v. n. (Proceed in a winding direction) visfp (c. 1. -sarpati -sarptuM), vakraM or kuwilaM gam. — (Turn, twine), see the words.
WIND UP: I Lit.: sampuwIkaroti.II To con- -clude: upasaMharati, (hf, c. 1.).
WIND-BOUND , a. vAtarudDaH -dDA -dDaM, vAyupratibadDaH &c., vAtabadDaH &c.
WIND-FALL , s. AgantukalABaH, AkasmikalABaH, alaByalABaH.
WIND-MILL , s. vAyusaYcAlitacakraM, vAyucakraM, vAtacakraM.
WINDFALL: I Lit.: *vAyupAtaH.II Fig.: Aka- smikasamAgamaH and sim. comp. s.
WINDING (subs.): vakram: v. Bend, crooked- -ness.
WINDING , s. vakratA, vakraM, vakrimA m. (n), puwaH, AvfttiH f., vyAvarttanaM; ‘of a river,’ roDovakratA, vakraM, vaNkaH, puwaBedaH.
WINDING , part. visarpI -rpiRI -rpi (n), vakragAmI &c.
WINDING-SHEET: AcCAdanam: v. Shroud, cover.
WINDING-SHEET , s. SavavastraM, SavavasanaM. See SHROUD.
WINDLASS: *uttolanayantram, uttolanI.
WINDMILL: *vAyucalaM cakram.

WINDOW: (1) vAtAyanam, taking to the w. s: vAtAyanasaMSrita (f. tA), R. vi. 24.;(2) gavAkzaH, the w. s filled with the faces: vyAptAntarA muKEstAsAM gavAkzAH R. vii. 11.;(3) jAlaH (lI, lam) another looking through the w.: jAlAntaraprezitadfzwi- ranyA, R. vii. 9.
WINDOW , s. vAtAyanaM, jAlaM -lakaH -likA, gavAkzaH -kzakaH, gfhAkzaH, pragrIvaH, muKaM, gfhamuKaM; ‘at the window,’ vAtAyanagataH, vAtAya- nasTaH, vAtAyanASritaH; ‘having a window,’ jAlI -linI &c.
Windpipe, s. SvAsanalikA.
WINDWARD (adj.): vAtABimuKa (f. KI) and sim. comp.s.
WINDY: (1) vAtala (f. lI);(2) vAtamaya (f. yI) and sim. comp. s.
WINDY , a. vAtalaH -lA -laM, vAtavAn -vatI -vat (t), vAyavaH -vI -vaM, vAyavyaH -vyA -vyaM, vAtamayaH -yI -yaM. See STORMY.
Wine, s. madyaM, drAkzArasaH-AsavaH; maDu n., mADvIkaM; madirA, surA ‘w(ine)-bibber’ madyapaH, susapaH; ‘w(ine)-seller’ madyavikrayin, SOMqikaH.

WINE: (1) madyam, to drink w.: madyaM pibati; to take w.: madyaM sevate, Ni.; new w.: navaM madyam, Sr.; w. pot: madyamARqam, P.; destroying the smell of w.: BadyaganDanASanam, Bha.;(2) madirA, w. -tasting: madirAsvAdaH, Si.;(3) maDu (poet.), sweet w.: svAdu maDu, Si.;(4) surA (= spirit), to make w.: surAM karoti, Mah.;(5) AsavaH (= liquor), taking of w.: Asavasevanam, D.

WINE , s. madyaM, drAkzArasaH, drAkzAmadyaM, drAkzAsavaH, drAkzAsurA, madirA, maDu n., maDvAsavaH, mADvI -DvIkaM, mADvakaM, maDumADvIkaM, mADavakaH, mArdvIkaM, surA -rI, hAlA, kaSyaM, rasitaH, mahAnandA, kAdambarI, pakvarasaH; ‘wine personified,’ surA -rI; ‘wine-drinker, wine-bibber,’ madyapaH, surApaH, madyapAyI m.; ‘wine-drinking,’ madyapAnaM.
WINE-BIBBER: (1) madyapaH;(2) madyapAyin (m.); (3) surApaH.
WINE-GLASS , s. madyapAtraM, surABAjanaM, cazakaH, see DRINKING-VESSEL.
WINE-MERCHANT , s. drAkzArasavikretA m. (tf), madyavikrayI m.
WINE-PRESS , s. drAkzApezaRayantraM, drAkzApezaRI.
WINE-SELLER: SORqikaH (f. kI, the Śuri caste).

Wing, s. pakzaH, patraM, patatraM, garut m., CadaH pakzman n., ‘root of a w(ing)’ pakzati f., pakzamUlaM; ‘to be on the w(ing)’ qI 1 A; ‘under the w(ing) of’ ASrita a. 2 (Of army &c.) pakzaH, dalaM, pArSvadalaM. v. t. ‘w(ing) the way’ aDvakramaRaM kf 8 U. [Wing]ed, a. pakzin, patatrin.

WING (subs.): I Lit.:(1) pakzaH, protected me with his own w. s: svapakzAByAM mAmarakzat, Vi. v. 5.; stretched the w. s and flew up to heaven: vitatya pakzO naBa utpapAta, Mah. i. 25. 17.; root of a w.: pakzatiH, N. ii. 2.;(2) patatram;(3) garut (m.: rare). Ph.: on the w.: qIyate: v. To fly.II Fig., as of an army: pakzaH, who formed side-w.s and w. s: ke te prapakzO pakzO vA, Mah. viii. 46. 6. Ph.: under the w. s of: expr. by: ASritaH (tA, taM).

WING , s. (Of a bird, &c.) pakzaH, pakzma n. (n), garut m., dehaDiH m., patraM, patatraM, CadaH -danaM, tanuruhaH, tanUruhaH, vAjaH, bAhukutTaH; ‘spreading its wings,’ pakzO prasAryya; ‘under the wing,’ pakzADas; ‘root of a wing,’ pakzamUlaM, pakzati. — (Of an army) pakzaH, senApakzaH, sEnyapakzaH, pArSvasTadalaM, cakraM. — (Of a house) gfhapakzaH, gfhapArSvaBAgaH.
WINGED: (1) pakzin (f. RI);(2) pakzavat (f. tI);(3) patatrin (f. RI);(4) pakzayukta (f. ktA); etc.
WINGED , a. pakzI -kziRI -kzi (n), pakzavAn -vatI &c., sapakzaH -kzA -kzaM, pakzayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, jAtapakzaH &c., patrI &c., patatrI &c.
Wink, v. i. ni-miz 6 P, ni-mIl 1 P, pakzma saMkuc 1 P. 2 saMketaM-saMjYAM-kf 8 U (netreRa); ‘w(ink) at’ upekz 1 A, na gaR 10. s. nimi(me)zaH, nimIlanaM, pakzmasaMkocaH. 2 netrasaMjYA, akzisaMketaH.
WINK (subs.): Of the eye: nimezaH. II Hint: (1) netrasaMketaH;(2) akzisaMjYA, and sim. comp. s.

WINK (v.): I Of the eye:(1) nimizati (miz, c. 6.);(2) nimIlati (mIl, c. 1. = close). II To make a sign: netreRa saNketaM dadAti (dA c. 3.) or saMjYAM karoti. W. at, i. e. connive: upekzate (Ikz, c. 1.).

WINK , s. (Of the eye) nimezaH -zakaH, nimizaH, nimIlanaM, mIlanaM, SmIlanaM, SmIlitaM, vikURanaM, karkarAwaH, akzipakzmaRaH saNkocaH. — (Sign, or hint made by the eye) netrasaNketaH, akzisaMjYA, akzisaNkocasaMjYA, BUsaMjYitaM, apANgadarSanaM, iNgitaM.

To WINK , v. n. (Close the eyelids quickly) nimiz (c. 6. -mizati -mezituM), miz, nimIl (c. 1. -mIlati -lituM), mIl, SmIl, akzipakzma saMkuc (c. 1. -kocati -cituM), kaR (c. 10. kaRayati -yituM), cUR, akzisaNkocaM kf. — (Make a sign with the eye) akzipakzmasaNkocena saNketaM kf or saMjYAM kf, netrasaNketaM kf. — (Wink at) upekz, see To CONNIVE.
WINKING , pdrt. nimizan -zantI -zat (t), nimIlan &c., saNkawAkzaH -kzA -kzaM, saNkucitAkzaH &c. — (Winking at) upekzI -kziRI &c.
WINNER: (1) jayin (f. nI), Mit.: v. Victor; (2) labDf (f. bDrI = gainer);(3) by verb.
WINNER , s. jetA m. (tf), jayI m. (n), vijetA m., vijayI m.
WINNING: I Subs.:(1) by verb: v. To win;(2) lABaH (= profit);(3) arjitam (= earning).II Adj.: hfdayahArin (f. RI): v. Charming.
WINNING , a. anuraYjakaH -kA -kaM, manoharaH &c., mitrayuH -yuH -yu.
Winnow, v. t. vi-, SuD c., pU 9 U. 2 prasPuw c.; (fig.) parIkz 1 A; See Discriminate. [Winnow]er, s. pAvakaH. [Winnow]ing, s. pavanaM, prasPowanaM; ‘w(innow)ing basket’ SUrpaH-rpaM, prasPowanaM.
WINNOW: I Lit.: SoDayati, vi- (c. of SuD): v. To cleanse, purify. Ph.: w. ing fan: sU(SU)rpa (mn.).II Fig.: to sift, examine: q. v.
To WINNOW , v. a. SuD (c. 10. SoDayati -yituM), nizpAvaM kf, pU, paripU, prasPuw (c. 10. -sPowayati -yituM), prasPowanaM kf. See To THRESH.
WINNOWED , p. p. pUtaH -tA -taM, paripUtaH &c., bahulIkftaH -tA -taM.
WINNOWER: (1) SoDaka (f. DikA);(2) pAvaka, -niH (f. vikA).
WINNOWER , s. pAvakaH, nizpAvakaH, prasPowanakArI m. (n).
WINNOWING , s. nizpAvaH, pavanaM, pavaH, prasPowanaM, bahulIkaraRaM, utkAraH, nikAraH; ‘winnowing-fan or basket,’ sUrppaH -rppaM, SUrppaH -rppaM, prasPowanaM.
WINNOWING-FAN: SU(sU)rpa (mn.), D. vi.; (2) prasPowanam (rare).
Winter, s. hemaMtaH, SiSiraH, tuzArakAlaH, himAgamaH, hima-SIta-kAlaH. Wintry, a. (s.) in comp.; hEmaMta (tI f.), hEma (mI f.). 2 SIta, SiSira.

WINTER (subs.): I The season:(1) hemantaH (Nov.-Jan.);(2) SiSiraH (Jan.-March);(3) himAgamaH, Si.;(4) tuzArakAlaH, Ki.; and sim. comp.s.II = year: Sarad (f. = autumn), ten thousand w. s passed: SaradAmayutaM yayO, R. x. 1.
WINTER (v.): hemantaM gamayati (c. of gam), nayati (nI, c. 1.), etc.: v. To pass.
WINTER , s. hemantaH -ntaM, hEmantaM, hemantakAlaH, himakAlaH, SItakAlaH, SiSiraH -raM, himarttuH m., SItarttuH, himAgamaH, hEmalaM.
To WINTER , v. n. hemantakAlaM gam (c. 10. gamayati -yituM) or nI.
WINTERY, WINTRY: I Lit.: expr. by comp. II Cold: q. v.: SIta (f. tA).
WINTERY , a. hEmantaH -ntI -ntaM, hEmantikaH -kI -kaM, hEmaH -mI -maM, hEmanaH -nI -naM, himakAlasambanDI &c.; ‘weather,’ himadurdinaM.

Wipe, v. t. pra-pari-mfj 2 P or c., pra-kzal 10, nirGfz 1 P, saM-mfd 9 P; See Wash; ‘w(ipe) away’, ‘w(ipe) out’ pramfj, (svaBAvaloletyayaSaH pramfzwaM) (R. vi. 41), apa-ava-mfj. s. mArjanaM, prakzAlanaM. 2 prahAraH. [Wip]er, s. mArjanI, prakzAlanI.

To WIPE , v. a. mfj (c. 2. mArzwi -rzwuM, c. 1. mArjati -rjituM), pramfj, Amfj, parimfj, sammfj, prakzal (c. 10. -kzAlayati -yituM), mfd, see To RUB; ‘the mouth,’ muKaM pramfj; ‘the eyes,’ netre parimfj; ‘tears from the eyes,’ netrAByAm aSrURi pramfj. — (Wipe away, wipe off) apamfj, avamfj, niHkzip; ‘dirt or defilement,’ malam apamfj, nirlepaM kf.
WIPE , s. mArjaH -rjanaM, prakzAlanaM. — (Blow) prahAraH, AGAtaH.
WIPED , p. p. mArjitaH -tA -taM, pramArjitaH &c.; ‘with the hand,’ samudDastaH &c.
WIPER , s. mArjanI, mArjanavastraM, prakzAlanI, varakaM.
Wire, s. taMtraM, taMtrI, tAraH-rA, DAtusUtraM, loha-tArA-sUtraM-taMtuH. v. t. tArAyaMtreRa prez c. [Wir]y, a. taMtramaya (yI f.).
WIRE: I Subs.:(1) tantram(ntrI);(2) tAraH.II Verb: tAqitatantreRa prezayati (c. of iz): v. To send.
WIRE , s. tAraH -rA, lohatArA, lohatantuH m., lohasUtraM, lohatantrI, SalAkA, DAtusUtraM, tantuH m., sUtraM, tantrI -ntraM.
To WIREDRAW , v. a. lohodvarttanaM kf, lohatArodvarttanaM kf.
WIRY , a. tantumayaH -yI -yaM, tantusaguRaH -RA -RaM, tantuprAyaH &c.
WISDOM: (1) prajYA;(2) jYAnam (= knowledge: q. v.);(3) budDiH (= intellect: q. v.)
WISDOM , s. jYAnaM, vijYAnaM, prajYA, budDiH f., prAjYatA, vijYatA, meDA, vEduzyaM, vidvattA, pARqityaM, manIzA, matiH f., vivekaH, hitAhitavivekaH, DIH f.; ‘god of wisdom,’ gaReSaH.

Wise, a. pra(prA)jYa, vijYa, vidagDa, jYAnavat, paMqita, prajYAvat, DImat, vivekin, suDI, DIra, mati-budDi-mat, manIzin, vidvas; See Learned also. 2 (Of acts) su in comp.; jYAnaprayukta, vEdagDyamUlakaH; ‘w(ise) saying’ suBAzitaM; ‘w(ise) step’ sADumArgaH. s. prakAraH; See Manner; ‘in this w(ise)’ evaM, itTaM. [Wise]ly, adv. prajYayA, jYAnena, savivekaM, samyak, susamIkzya, suzWu, prAjYavat. Wisdom, s. prajYA, jYAnaM, vEdagDyaM, budDi f., DIH, vivekaH, vEduzyaM, pAMqityaM, DIratA, manIzA. Wiseacre, s. paMqitaMmanyaH.

WISE: I Having wisdom:(1) prAjYa (f. jYA); (2) vijYa (f. jYA);(3) prajYAvat (f. tI);(4) DImat (f. tI): v. Intelligent;(5) jYAnin (f. nI): v. Learned;(6) vivekin (f. nI): v. Prudent.II Of acts etc.: w. saying: buDaBAzitam; w. action: jYAnamUlA kriyA; w. intellect: vivekinI matiH; w. deportment: vivekavyavahAraH; etc.
WISE (subs.): v. Manner, way. Ph.: in no w.: na kaTaYcana; in any wise: kenApi prakAreRa.

WISE , a. (Having wisdom) vidvAn -duzI -dvat (t), jYAnI -ninI -ni (n), jYAnavAn -vatI -vat (t), prAjYaH -jYA -jYaM, prajYaH &c., budDimAn -matI &c., matimAn &c., DImAn &c., prajYAvAn &c., paRqitaH -tA -taM, vijYaH -jYA -jYaM, vivekI -kinI &c., prajYI &c., meDAvI -vinI &c., savivekaH -kA -kaM, kovidaH -dA -daM, -suDIH -DIH -Di, suboDaH -DA -DaM, kftaDIH &c., DIraH -rA -raM, viSezajYaH -jYA -jYaM, kftyajYaH &c., nipuRa- dfk m. f. n. (S), prekzAvAn &c., marmmajYaH &c.; ‘a wise man,’ vidvajjanaH, buDaH, see LEARNED. — (Dictated by wisdom) jYAna- prayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, budDiprayuktaH &c., jYAnamUlakaH -kA -kaM, budDimUlakaH &c.
WISE , s. See MANNER, WAY; ‘in no wise,’ na kaTaYcana.
WISEACRE: (1) paRqitABimAnin (f. nI);(2) paRqitammanya (f. nyA); etc.
WISEACRE , s. paRqitammanyaH, jYammanyaH, alpabudDiH m.
WISELY: (1) prajYayA;(2) jYAnena;(3) savivekam (= prudently);(4) prasamIkzya (= considerate- -ly);(5) samyak (= well).
WISELY , adv. vidvajjanavat, prAjYavat, vijYavat, sajYAnaM, savivekaM, viveka- pUrvvaM, samyak, suzWu, yuktaM.

Wish, v. t. iz 6 P, spfh 10 (with dat.), saM-, Ih 1 A, vAMC 1 P, A-, kAMkz 1 P, aBilaz 1, 4 P, kam 1 A, vaS 2 P; oft. by desid. forms; jigamizati ‘w(ish)es to go’; jiGfkzati &c.; ‘w(ish) ill to’ asUyati (D.) (with dat.); amaMgalaM ASaMs 1 A; ‘I w(ish) no evil to any’ na me kasminnapi drohabudDiH-dvezaBAvaH; ‘I w(ish) I could see him again’ api nAma taM punarapi paSyeyaM; ‘he had nothing left to w(ish) for’ na kimapi tasya spfhaRIyamAsIt. s. icCA, manoraTaH, spfhA, IhA, kAmaH, izwaM, vAMCitaM, aBilAzaH; vAMCA, kAMkzA.

WISH (v.): icCati (iz, c. 6.), I w. to know from the beginning: AditaH SrotumicCAmi, Mu. ii.; (2) aBilazati (laz, c. 1.), w.ing valour: vikramamaBilazat (f. ntI), Ki. xvii. 64.;(3) kAmayate, aBi- (kam, c. 1.), I do not w. such decrepitude: tAM jarAM na kAmaye, Mah.;(4) vAYCati (vAYC, c. 1.);(5) kANkzati (kANkz, c. 1.); (6) by desi.: v. Also to long.
WISH (subs.): (1) icCA;(2) kAmanA;(3) manoraTaH; (4) izwam;(5) Ipsitam;(6) vAcCitam: v. Desire.

To WISH , v. n. iz (c. 6. icCati, ezituM), aBilaz (c. 1. -lazati -zituM), vAYC (c. 1. vAYCati -YCituM), kAMkz (c. 1. kAMkzati -kzituM), AkAMkz, see To DESIRE. Often expressed by the desid. form of a root; as, ‘to wish to obtain,’ Ap in des. (Ipsati -psituM), laB in des. (lipsate -psituM); ‘to wish to go,’ gam in des. (jigami- zati -zituM).
To WISH , v. a. (Well to one) izwaM or maNgalam or kalyARam ASaMs (c. 1. -SaMsate -situM) or ASAs (c. 2. SAste -situM) or prArT. — (Wish one ill) anizwaM or amaNgalam ASaMs or prArT.
WISH , s. icCA, aBilAzaH, AkAMkzA, izwaM, spfhA, manoraTaH, IpsitaM, see DESIRE; ‘according to one's wish,’ yaTABimataM; ‘earnest wish,’ kOtUhalaM, kutUhalaM, see LONGING.
WISHED , p. p. izwaH -zwA -zwaM, aBIzwaH -zwA -zwaM. See DESIRED.
WISHING , part. or a. icCuH -cCuH -cCu, AkAMkzI &c. See DESIROUS.
Wisp, s. SuzkatfRakUrcakaH.
WISP: a small bundle: kUrca (mn.), -ka (mn.).
WISP , s. (Of straw) SuzkatfRakUrccakaH, SuzkanAlagucCakaH.

Wit, s. budDi-mati f., meDA, DIH; See Intellect. 2 budDitIkzRatA, budDivilAsaH-cAturyaM; ‘was at his w(it)ʼs end’ kiMvaktavyatAmUQaH-kuMWitamatiH-AsIt, niruttarIkftaH. 3 (Person) vAkcaturaH, narmajYaH, parihAsakaTaH, narmaBAzin m. 4 rasaH, narman n., vEdagDyaM, sArasyaM, narma-rasika-ukti f., narmAlApaH-BAzaRaM; ‘to w(it)’ tadyaTA. [Wit]ty, a. narmavedin, narmaBAzin, sarasa, vidagDa, rasayukta; parihAsajanana (nI f.); ‘w(itty) speech’ parihAsAlApaH, narmavAkyaM, narmAlApaH.
WIT: I Intellect: q. v.: DIH.II Humour: (1) prajYA (?);(2) sarasatA (?).III A witty man: vAkcatura (f. rA) and sim. comp.s (?). Ph.: to w.; tadyaTA: v. Namely.

WIT , s. (Understanding) budDiH f., matiH f., DIH f.; ‘one who has lost his wits,’ nazwabudDiH -dDiH -dDi. — (Quickness of fancy) budDi- pAwavaM, budDicAturyyaM, budDivilAsaH, budDikOSalaM, budDitIkzRatA, vEdagDyaM, vidagDatA. — (Humour) rasaH, rasikavAkyaM, rasikoktiH f., narmmoktiH f., narmma n. (n), marmma n. — (A wit, man of wit) rasajYaH, narmmajYaH, narmma- vedI m. (n), parihAsavedI m., narmmaBApI m. — (To wit) vastutas, arTatas.
Witch, s. qAkinI, mAyAvinI, kuhakinI, mAyinI. [Witch]ery, ‘w(itch)-craft’, s. mAyA, aBicAraH.
WITCH: (1) qAkinI;(2) mAyAvinI;(3) mAyinI; (4) kuhakinI.
WITCH , s. mAyinI, pUtanA, qAkinI. See SORCERESS.
WITCHCRAFT: mAyA: v. Sorcery.
WITCHCRAFT , s. mAyA, aBicAraH, pUtanAtvaM. See SORCERY.

With, prep. Gen. ex. by instr. 2 (Manner) by instr.; prItyA ‘w(ith) affection’; by comp. with sa; saharzaM, saBayaM &c.; pUrvaM, pUrvakaM in comp.; ‘w(ith) respect’ mAnapuraHsaraM, AdarapUrvakaM. 3 (Accompaniment) by Bah. comp.; ‘Madana w(ith) Rati’ ratisahAyo madanaH; sakfzRo rAmaH; gen. by samaM, sAkaM, sArDaM, saha, sahitaM, with instr.; ‘send the book w(ith) Rāma’ rAmahaste pustakaM prezaya. 4 (With verbs) saM; ‘to live w(ith)’ saM-vas. 5 (On the side of) pakze. 6 (In the option of) matena, mate (tava matenAkiMcitkaramidaM); ‘w(ith) all’ anAdftya; See ‘in spite or’ under Spite. [With]al, adv. samaM, taTA ca, api ca, taTEva.

WITH: I Denoting instrument, means: by ins., to play w. dice: akzErdIvyati, Ve. i. 13.; not only w. (their) hearts: na kevalaM hfdayena, N. xi. 2.; he was looked w. greater respect: gOraveRa dadfSetarAmasO, Si. xiv. 43.II Along w.: by ins. gen. with saha (or rarely) sAkaM, sArDam, samam, to live w. Brahmans: brAhmaRErvasati, Mah. i. 84. 2.; did not burn himself w. the queen: na cakAra SarIramagnisAt saha devyA, R. viii. 72.; w. Uddhava and Balavbhadra: sArDamudDavasIriByAm, Si. ii. 2.; w. your fame, your body is getting thin: parEti kArSyaM yaSasA samaM vapuH, Ki. i. 39. III Denoting manner:(1) by adv. with sa, w. pleasure: saharzam; w. alarm: sodvegam; (2) by adj., w. great pleasure: mudA paramayA yutaH; w. stick in hand: daRqahastaH; etc.; the goddess w. ten arms: daSaBujA.IV On the side of: the divine sages were w. the sons of Pāṇḍu: devarzIRAM gaRAH pARqavato'Bavan, Mah. viii. 87. 51.V In the opinion of: expr. w. matam, “w. the ancients”: prAcAM mate.VI With verbs denoting resentment etc.: by dat. (G.). Ph.: one w. another:(1) parasparam;(2) anyo'nyam. N. B. w. with verbs is also expr. by sam- in comp., to live w.: saMvasati.

WITH , prep. (Denoting cause, means, instrument) usually expressed by the instrumental case; as, ‘with a sword,’ KaNgena; ‘with grief,’ Sokena. — (In opposition to, against) instr. c., with or without saha; as, ‘to fight with one's enemies,’ SatruBiH or SatruBiH saha yuD or expressed by upari or by the dat. or gen. c., in such phrases as, ‘he is angry with his son,’ putrasyopari or putrAya or putrasya kruDyati. — (In com- pany, together with, along with) saha, sArdDaM, samaM, sAkaM, sahitaM, satraM -trA, amA all with the instrum. c.: ‘along with me,’ mayA saha; ‘along with him,’ tena saha. The preposition sam, prefixed to roots, gives this sense of ‘with;’ as, ‘to live in company with,’ saMvas. — (Associated, attondedattended, connected with) sahitaH -tA -taM in comp. or expressed by the instr. c., with or without saha, or by pUrvva or zuraHsara in comp.; as, ‘associated with enemies,’ SatrusahitaH -tA -taM or SatruBiH sahitaH &c. — (Denoting manner) expressed by instr. c., or by sa in comp. with the accus. n., or by pUrvvaM or pUrvvakaM or puraHsaraM affixed; as, ‘with anger,’ kopena, sakopaM, kopapUrvvaM, kopapUrvvakaM, kopapuraHsaraM; ‘with respect,’ sAdaraM; ‘with affection,’ prItipUrvvaM. — (Among) maDye. To express a person with any thing in his possession, or a thing in connection with some- thing else, a compound adjective may often be used; thus, ‘a man with a stick in his hand,’ daRqahastaH puruzaH; ‘a man with riches,’ saDanaH or DanavAn puruzaH; a ship with two [Page843-b+ 51] masts,’ dvikUpakA nOH or kUpakadvayayuktA nOH.
WITHAL: (1) samameva (= at the same time); (2) taTA ca (=likewise).
WITHAL , adv. samaM, taTEva, apica, aparaYca. See LIKEWISE.

Withdraw, v. t. prati-, saM-hf 1 P, apAkfz 1 P, apa-nI 1 P, pratyava-hf; ‘w(ithdraw)s the world into himself’ AtmanyevAKilaM viSvaM saMharati. v. i. apa-kram 1 U, 4 P, apa-sf 1 P, apa-gam 1 P, parAvft 1 A; See Retire. [Withdraw]al, s. saMhAraH, saMharaRaM, apanayanaM, apakramaH-maRaM.

WITHDRAW: (1) apanayati (nI, c. 1.): v. To remove, take away;(2) saMharati, upa-, prati- (hf, c. 1. = draw back), w. ing and throwing: saMhAravikzepO, R. v. 45.;(3) apakarzati or apA- (kfz, c. 1.): v. To draw away, draw off.
WITHDRAW (v. i.): (1) apakrAmati (kram, c. 1.); (2) apasarati (sf, c. 1.): v. To retire, flee.
To WITHDRAW , v. a. apanI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM), vinI, vyapanI, apa- kfz (c. 1. -karzati -karzwuM), apAkfz, apahf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), vyapahf, upasaMhf, pratisaMhf, saMhf.
To WITHDRAW , v. n. apakram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), apasf (c. 1. -sarati -sarttuM), parAvft, avasTA, palAy, cal. See To RETIRE.
WITHDRAWAL , s. (Taking back) apanayaH -yanaM, apaharaRaM, upasaMhAraH -haraRaM. — (Retiring) apakramaH, apAyaH, see RETIREMENT.
WITHDRAWN , p. p. apanItaH -tA -taM, upasaMhftaH &c., parAvfttaH -ttA -ttaM.
Wither, v. i. mlE 1 P, glE 1 P, vi-SF pass.; sad 1 P, kzi pass. v. t. naS c., SF c.; See Fade. [Wither]ed, a. mlAna, glAna, viSIrRa, Suzka, jIrRa.
WITHER: I Intrans.: mlAyati (mlE, c. 1.): v. To fade, waste.II Trans.: mlApayati, pari- (c. of mlE).
To WITHER , v. n. viSF in pass. (-SIryyate), mlE (c. 1. mlAyati, mlAtuM), naS (c. 4. naSyati), sad, kzi. See To FADE, v. n.
To WITHER , v. a. naS (c. 10. nASayati -yituM). See To FADE, v. a.

WITHERED , p. p. viSIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, mlAnaH -nA -naM, SuzkaH -zkA -zkaM, gatarasaH -sA -saM, see FADED; ‘a withered leaf,’ jIrRaparRaM; ‘hav- ing a withered arm or hand,’ vikalapARikaH -kA -kaM, kukaraH -rA -raM, kuRiH m., kURiH, koRiH.
Withers, s. skaMDadeSaH, skaMDaH.
WITHERS: skanDaH, -deSaH.
WITHERS , s. (Of an elephant, &c.) skanDadeSaH, skanDaH, AsanaM.
WITHHELD , p. p. upasaMhftaH -tA -taM, pratyAhftaH &c., apahftaH &c., viDftaH &c., viDAritaH &c., nigfhItaH &c., ucCinnaH -nnA -nnaM.
Withhold, v. i. nigrah 9 P, ava-ni-ruD 7 U, niyam 1 P, prati-saMhf 1 P, apasaM-hf, vi-Df 10; na dA 3 U.
WITHHOLD: (1) saMharati (hf, c. 1. draw back), w. your anger: kroDaM saMhara, Ku. iii. 72.;(2) nigfhnAti (grah, c. 9.): v. To restrain, check; (3) pratibaDnAti (banD, c. 9.): v. To obstruct.
To WITHHOLD , v. a. upasaMhf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), pratyAhf, saMhf, viDf (c. 10. -DArayati -yituM), ucCid (c. 7. -Cinatti -CettuM), nigrah, vinigrah, niyam, niruD. See To RESTRAIN, RETAIN.

Within, adv. aMtar in comp.; aMtarvartin. 2 cittodBUta, AMtara (a.). prep. aMtare, aByaMtare, maDye, aMtar in comp.; ‘w(ithin) the house’ gfhAByaMtare, aMtargfhaM &c.; ‘w(ithin) six months’ zaRmAsAByaMtare, zaRmAsamaDye; arvAk (with abl.). 2 (In the reach of) gocara, vizaya, grAhya, in comp.; ‘w(ithin) hearing’ karRagocarIBUta; ‘w(ithin) the reach of eyes’ nayanagocare, nayanavizaye &c.; ‘w(ithin) the reach of the hand’ hastaprApya-grAhya.
WITHIN (adj. or adv.): antar: v. Inner, inward, in.

WITHIN (prep.): I Inside: w. the house: antargfham, gfhAByantare or gfhamaDye: v. Also in. II Of time: w. ten days: antardaSAhAt, M. viii. 222; w. a week: saptAhamaDye, K. b. or saptAhAByantare, Mit. or saptAhAt, M. viii. 108.: [Page765] v. Also in.III In the limits of: w. sight: dfzwigocara (f. rA): w. one's power: hastavartin (f. nI); w. arrow-shot: bARavizaya (f. yA); etc.

WITHIN , prep. (In the inner part) antar, aByantare, antare; ‘within the house,’ gfhAByantare; ‘being within the house,’ gfhAntarvarttI -rttinI &c., gfhAntargataH -tA -taM, gfhAntaHsTaH -sTA -sTaM. — (Not later than) maDye, arvAk, see UNDER; ‘within a year,’ saMvatsaramaDye; ‘within ten days,’ daSAhamaDye. — (In the limits or compass of) gocaraH -rA -raM, vizaya in comp., gamya or grAhya &c. in comp.; ‘within hearing,’ karRagocaraH -rA -raM; ‘within sight,’ dfzwi- gocaraH -rA -raM, dfggocaraH &c., dfzwigamyaH -myA -myaM, dfzwivizayaH -yA -yaM; ‘within arrow-shot,’ vARagocaraH -rA -raM; ‘within reach of the hand,’ hastagrAhyaH -hyA -hyaM, hastaprApyaH &c., hastavarttI -rttinI &c.
WITHIN , adv. antar, aByantare, see INWARDLY; ‘gone within,’ antargataH -tA -taM; ‘being within,’ antarBavaH -vA -vaM, antarvarttI &c.

Without, prep. vinA (with acc., instr., abl.), aMtareRa (with acc.), fte (with abl.) varjayitvA, muktvA, vihAya (with acc.); by a-nir pr., hIna, rahita, varjita, vyatirekeRa, vyatiriktaM in comp.; ‘w(ithout) delay’ avilaMbaM; ‘w(ithout) doubt’ niHsaMSayaM, asaMSayaM; ‘w(ithout) money’ DanahIna-rahita, nirDana. 2 (Before participles) By a (an); ‘w(ithout) burning’ adahan, adagDvA; ‘w(ithout) being marked’ alakzita. 3 bahiH (with abl.), bahirBAge. adv. bahiH, bAhyataH; ‘lying w(ithout)’ bahiHsTita.

WITHOUT (prep.): I Before nouns:(1) vinA (with ins. or acc., rarely with abl.), I can- not remain a moment w. you: na Saknomi mavatA vinA kzaRamazyavasTAtum, K.;(2) by negatives, w. eyes He sees, w. ears He hears: paSyatyacakzuH sa SfRotyakarRaH, S.: v. Devoid of;(3) antareRa (with acc.: rarely), there is no pleasure w. God: antareRa hariM na suKam, S. k.;(4) fte (with acc. and abl.), w. a general: fte senApraRetAram, Mah. v. 150-2.(5) by part.s, varjayitvA (= leav- -ing off) etc.; “na BUridAnaM virahayya satkriyAm”, Ki. i. 12.; “na hIndriyARyanupAdAya pratyakzAdivyavahAraH samBavati”, S.II Before part.s: a (an, before vowels), w. reducing dust to mud: anItvA paNkatAM DUlim, Si. ii. 34.; w. being seen: alakzitaH (tA, taM), etc.III Outside of: q. v.: bahiH (with abl.).
WITHOUT (adv.): bahis, lying w.: bahiHsTa (f. sTA): v. Externally, outside.

WITHOUT , prep. (Not with) vinA with instr. or acc. c., fte with abl. or acc. c., antareRa with abl. or acc. or gen., antarA, vyatirekeRa in comp., vyatiriktaM, pfTak, a prefixed; ‘without ornament,’ BUzaRena vinA or BUzaRaM vinA; ‘without feeling,’ rasAd fte; ‘without punishment,’ daRqavyatirekeRa, daRqamantareRa; ‘without delay,’ avilambena; ‘without beginning or end,’ anAdyantaH -ntA -ntaM; ‘without doubt,’ asaMSayaM; ‘without reason,’ asamBAvanIyaM; ‘without cause,’ prayojanaM vinA, akasmAt or expressed by the loc. abs., asati prayojane. — (Destitute of) hInaH -nA -naM, vihInaH &c., rahitaH -tA -taM, virahitaH &c. or ex- pressed by a, nir, vi &c. prefixed; ‘without money,’ DanahInaH -nA -naM, DanarahitaH &c., aDanaH -nA -naM, nirDanaH &c.; ‘how can I go without you?’ kaTaM tvadvihIno yAsyAmi. — (Unless, if not, except) yadi na, antareRa with acc., or expressed by the indec. part. with a or na prefixed; ‘without you do that,’ yadi na tata karozi or tad akftvA; ‘without drinking [Page844-a+ 51] any water,’ pAnIyam apItvA; ‘it cannot be seen without a telescope,’ dUradarSakayantramantareRa na dfSyate; ‘this cannot be ascertained without algebra,’ vIjagaRitam antareRa na jYAyate tat. — (On the outside of) vahis, vahirBAge, antareRa; ‘without the fort,’ durgavahis, durgavahirBAge, durgAdantareRa.
WITHOUT , adv. (Not within) vahis, avas. — (Externally) vAhyatas.
Withstand, v. t. nirA-prati-kf 8 U, pratikUlayati (D.), vi-ruD 7 U, paripaMTIBU 1 P, (badDaparikarasya tena trElokyamapi kzamaM paripaMTIBavituM Ve. 3); pratyavasTA 1 A; See Oppose.
WITHSTAND: pratikUlayati (nomi.): v. To resist, oppose.
To WITHSTAND , v. a. paryavasTA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM), pratikUla (nom. pratikUlayati -yituM), viruD. See To RESIST, OPPOSE.

Witness, s. sAkzin m.; ‘w(itness)es for prosecution’ pUrvavAdinaH sAkziRaH; ‘ear-w(itness)’ SrutasAkzI; ‘eye-w(itness)’ dfzwasAkzI. 2 sAkzAt drazwf m. 3 sAkzyaM, pramARaM. v. t. pratyakzIkf 8 U, pratyakzaM dfS 1 P; See See. 2 sAkzyeRa pramARIkf. v. i. sAkzyaM dA 3 U, sAkzIBU 1 P.

WITNESS (subs.): I The person w. ing: sAkzin (m.), one w. is no w.: ekaScAsAkzI, V. s.; and among women, women (will be) w. es: striyaH strIzu ca sAkziRaH, N. s.; in the absence of w. es: sAkzyaBAve, M.; to cite, swear, examine w. es: sAkziRaH diSati, SApayati, parIkzate, M.; w. es for the prosecution, for the defence: sAkziRaH pUrvavAdinaH, uttaravAdinaH, Y.; ear-w.: SrutasAkzI, Mit.; to produce w. es: sAkziRa upanyasyati, Mit.; “jAgara- duHKasAkziRI niSA ca SayyA ca”, N. i. 49.II Testimony: sAkzyam, to bear w.: sAkzyaM dadAti, Y.
WITNESS (v. i.): sAkzyaM dadAti (dA, c. 3.), Y. or vadati (vad, c. 1.).
WITNESS (v. t.): I To see or know: q. v.: (1) pratyakzIkaroti, I will w. the king's doing: rAjarzervfttAntaM pratyakzIkarizyAmi, Sa. vi.;(2) expr. by subs.II To testify: q. v.

WITNESS , s. (Testimony) sAkzyaM, sAkzitA, pramARaM; ‘false witness,’ kUwasAkzyaM, miTyAsAkzyaM, ataTyasAkzyaM. — (Person who gives tes- timony) sAkzI m. (n), pramAtA m. (tf), sAkzyadAtA m., sAkzyakArI m.; ‘false witness,’ kUwasAkzI m., kOwasAkzI m., kUwakAraH -rakaH; ‘having witnesses,’ sAkzimAn -matI -mat (t); ‘proved by them,’ sAkziBAvitaH -tA -taM; ‘absence of them,’ sAkzyaBAvaH; ‘examination of a witness,’ sAkziparIkzA. — (One who is personally present) pratyakzadarSI m., sAkzAddrazwA m., see EYE-WITNESS.

To WITNESS , v. a. (See by personal presence) pratyakzaM or pratyakzatas or svacakzuzA dfS (c. 1. paSyati, drazwuM), sAkzAd dfS, pratyakzadarSanaM kf. — (Attest) sAkzyaM dA, sAkzyeRa pramARIkf, see To ATTEST.
To WITNESS , v. n. sAkzyaM dA, sAkzyaM kf, sAkzitAM dA, sAkzI BU, pramARIkf, pramARIBU. See To TESTIFY.
WITNESSED , p. p. (Seen in person) pratyakzadfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, sAkzAddfzwaH &c., svacakzuzA dfzwaH &c. — (Attested) pramARIkftaH -tA -taM, sAkzikaH -kI -kaM, sasAkzikaH &c.
WITTICISM: (1) prAjYaBAzitam;(2) sarasoktiH;(3) narmavAkyam (?).
WITTICISM , s. rasikavAkyaM, rasikoktiH f., sarasoktiH f., sarasavAkyaM, narmmo- ktiH f., narmmaBAzaRaM, vinodavAkyaM.
WITTILY: (1) sarasam (= humorously);(2) budDivilAsena (?);(3) BaNgyA (?).
WITTILY , adv. sarasaM, rasikoktyA, budDivilAsena, narmmoktyA.
WITTINGLY , adv. jYAnatas, budDipUrvvaM, kAmatas. See KNOWINGLY.
WITTY: (1) prAjYa (f. jYA = wise);(2) rasika (f. kA = humorous): v. Also wit (III).

WITTY , a. (Of persons) rasajYaH -jYA -jYaM, narmmajYaH &c., rasavedI -dinI -di (n), narmmavedI &c., narmmaBAzI -ziRI &c., narmmavaktA -ktrI -ktf (ktf), vidUzakaH -kA -kaM, vidagDaH -DA -DaM. — (Of sayings, &c.) rasikaH -kA -kaM, sarasaH -sA -saM, rasI -sinI &c., rasavAn -vatI -vat (t).
Wizard, s. mAyAkAraH; See Magician.
WIZARD: mAyAkAraH: v. Magician, sorcerer.
WIZARD , s. aBicAravid m., mAyAkAraH. See MAGICIAN.
Wizen, a. mlAna, glAna.
WOAD: latAviSezaH.
Woe, s. duHKaM, SokaH; See Sorrow, Grief. interj. hA, Dik, (with acc.); aho bata, hA kazwaM. [Woe]ful, a. Sorrowful, q. v.; ‘is in a w(oeful) plight’ kazwamaByApannaH (U. 3).
WOE: I Subs.: duHKam: v. Distress, sorrow. II Interj.:(1) hA (= alas);(2) Dik (= shame).
WOE , s. duHKaM, SokaH, durgatiH f., see MISERY, SORROW, CALAMITY. — (Exclam.) hA, vata, Dika.
Wold, s. vanaM, araRyaM. 2 giriH.
Wolf, s. vfkaH, kokaH, IhAmfgaH.
WOLF: (1) vfkaH, she-w.: vfkI;(2) kokaH;(3) IhAmfgaH (rare).
WOLF , s. vfkaH, kokaH, araRyaSvA m. (n), IhAmfgaH, IhAvfkaH, CAgaBo- jI m. (n), janASanaH.
WOLF'S BANE: vatsanABajAtIyo vfkzaBedaH.

Woman, s. strI, nArI, aMganA, abalA, yozit, vanitA, lalanA, yozA, sImaMtinI, vaDUH, vAmA, mahilA; ‘nobly-born w(oman)’ kulAMganA, kulajA, ‘young w(oman)’ yuvatiH-tI, yUnI, taruRI, pramadA, bAlA, ‘beautiful w(oman)’ suMdarI, pramadA, suBagA, nitaMbinI, vAmalocanA; ‘an excellent w(oman)’ varArohA, mattakASinI, usamA, varavarRinI; ‘passionate w(oman)’ kopanA, BAminI; ‘old w(oman)’ sTavirA, vfdDA, jaratI ‘virtuous w(oman)’ satI, sADvI, pativratA, sucaritrA, kulastrI, kulapAlikA. [Woman]hood, s. yOvanaM. [Woman]ish, a. strIvat ind., strERa (RI f.). [Woman]kind, s. strIjanaH, abalAjanaH, strERa. [Woman]ly, a. (s.) in comp.; ‘with w(omanly) timidity’ strIsvaBAvasulaBakAtaratayA.

WOMAN: (1) strI, for as w. should not leave (their) husbands: atyAjyo hi yaTA BartA strIRAm, M. p. 71. 11.; w.'s (separate) property: strIDanam, Da. 53.;(2) nArI, six vices of w.: nArIRAM dUzaRAni zaw, H. 114.;(3) aNganA, what fault w. really have: dozo'sti satyaM kataro'NganAnAm, V. m. 74. 6.;(4) pramadA, that w. follow the way of their husbands: pramadA pativartmagA iti, Ku. iv. 33.;(5) abalA;(6) yozit;(7) vaDUH (sp. married w.);(8) kAminI;(9) nitambinI; (10) vilAsinI;(11) sImantinI;(12) varArohA; (13) mattakASinI;(14) by adj., young w.: yuvatI; old w.: vfdDA; w. with beautiful brows: suBrUH. N. B. 8. to 13 are for beautiful w.

WOMAN , s. strI, nArI, aNganA, vanitA, yozit f., yozitA, yozA, jozita f., jozitA, jozA, narI, mAnavI, mahilA, abalA, manuzI, mAnuzI, kAminI, vAmA, vilAsinI, pramadA, mAninI, vaDUH f., mahelA -likA, mahIlA, lalanA, lalitA, ramaRI, rAmA, prakftiH f., sIma- ntinI, pratIpadarSinI, BaraRyA, parigfhyA; ‘a young woman,’ taruRI, kanyA, bAlA, yuvatI, yUnI, navayOvanA; ‘assembly of young women,’ yOvataM, yOvanaM; ‘an old woman,’ vfdDA, vfdDastrI, jaratI, palitA, paliknI; ‘a woman of good family,’ kulastrI, kula- nArI, kulANganA; ‘a beautiful woman,’ sundarI, pramadA, kAntA, suBagA, nitambinI, vAmalocanA, ‘an excellent woman,’ varANganA, varArohA, uttamA, varavarRinI, mattakASinI, mattakAsinI, strIratnaM; ‘a passionate woman,’ kopanA, BAminI; ‘virtuous woman,’ satI, sADvI, sucaritrA, kulastrI, kulapAlikA; ‘clever woman,’ [Page844-b+ 51] saraKatI; ‘woman who has borne a child,’ pramUtA -tikA; ‘married woman,’ saBarttfkA, sanATA; ‘woman-killer,’ strIGA- takaH; ‘woman-hater,’ strIdvezI m. The Hindūs divide women into four classes, corresponding to the four classes of men. These are, 1. padminI, comprising the most ex- cellent women; 2. citriRI or hariRI or mfgI, comprising well-educated, accomplished, and beautiful women; 3. SaNKi- nI, comprising women who are tall, neither stout nor thin, with long hair, irascible, and with strong passions; 4. hastinI, comprising women who are short, stout, with curly hair and furious passions.
WOMAN-HOOD , s. strItA, strItvaM, nArItvaM, strERaM, strIDarmmaH.
WOMANISH: strORa (f. RI): v. Effeminate.
WOMANISH , WOMANLY, a. strERaH -RI -RaM. See FEMININE.
WOMANISHLY: strIvat (= like a woman), Ve. v.
WOMANKIND , s. strIjAtiH f., strIprakftiH f., strIjanAH m. pl.
WOMANLY: (1) by comp.;(2) strERa (f. RI): v. Feminine.
Womb, s. garBaH, garBASayaH, garBasTAnaM.
WOMB: garBaH: v. Also uterus.
WOMB , s. garBASayaH, garBasTAnaM, yoniH m. f., yonI, garBakoSaH, jarAyuH m., garBaH, kozaH, udaraM, jaWaraH -raM, mAtfkukziH m., ulvaM, kalalaH -laM, catvAlaH, DarA.
WON , p. p. jitaH -tA -taM, nirjitaH &c., upArjitaH -tA -taM.

Wonder, s. vismayaH, camatkAraH, AScaryaM, kOtukaM. 2 adButaM, citraM, adButavastu; ‘it is no w(onder) that’ nEtaccitraM yad &c., kimatra citraM; ‘w(onder)-struck’ vismaTAkula-upahata-Apanna. v. i. vi-smi 1 A, by (s.) in comp.; ‘w(onder)ed at hearing the news’ vArtASravaRena saMjAtavismayaH-savismayaH-baBUva. [Wonder]ful, Wondrous, a. adButa, AScaryaBUta, vismayakara (rI f.), AScarya, vi-, citra, vismApaka. [Wonder]fully, adv. adButaM, sAScaryaM. [Wonder]ingly, adv. savismayaM, sAScaryaM.

WONDER (subs.): I Astonishment:(1) vismayaH, with eyes blooming with, w.: vismaya- vikasitAkzI, D. i.;(2) camatkAraH, camatkAritA; (3) AScaryam, -tvam;(4) citrIyA (rare).II Anything w. ful:(1) adButam, great w. to us: mahadadButaM naH, Vi. iv. 50;(2) AScaryam, it is a great w.: idameva mahadAScaryam, K.;(3) citram (= strange: q. v.), it is no w.: nEtaccitram, Sa. ii. 16.

WONDER (v.): (1) vismayate (smi, c. 1.), neither w. ed nor felt dejected: na visismiye na vizasAda, Ki. xi. 5.;(2) gen. by subs. or adj.; w. ing at the speech: tAM SrutvA saYjAtavismayaH, K.; w. ing: savismayaH, R. xvi. 6.

WONDER , s. (The emotion) vismayaH, AScaryyaM -ryyatvaM, camatkAraH, citraM, vicitrakaM. — (A wonder, cause of wonder) AScaryyaM, adButaM, adButavastu n., kOtukaM, camatkAraH, camatkftiH f., citraM, vicitratA, see MARVEL; ‘a great wonder,’ mahadAScaryyaM; ‘wonder of the world,’ BuvanAdButaM.
To WONDER , v. n. vismi (c. 1. -smayate -smetuM), vimmayApannaH -nnA -nnaM BU, vismitaH -tA -taM BU, savismayaH -yA -yaM BU, vismayAnvitaH -tA -taM BU, kuhukuha (nom. kuhukuhAyate). See To MARVEL.
WONDER-STRUCK , a. vismitaH -tA -taM, vismayAkulaH -lA -laM.
WONDER-WORKING , a. AScaryyakarmmA -rmmA -rmma (n), adButakarmmA &c., citrakarmmA &c., vicitrakarmmA &c.
WONDERFUL, WONDROUS: (1) AScarya (f. ryA); (2) adButa (f. tA);(3) vismayakara (f. rI); (4) vismayajanana (f. nI);(5) vismApaka (f. pikA).
WONDERFUL , WONDROUS, a. AScaryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, adButaH -tA -taM, citraH -trA -traM, vicitrakaH &c., citrI -triRI &c., vismApakaH &c. See MARVELLOUS.

Wont, s. aByAsaH, rIti f., saMpradAyaH, AcAraH, nityavyavahAraH. [Wont]ed, a. paricita, nitya; amyasta; ‘w(onted) nature’ svaBAvaH, prakfti f., See Nature; ‘to bring to oneʼs w(onted) nature’ prakftO sTA c., prakftisTa a. kf.
WONT: I Subs.: rItiH: v. Habit, custom. II Adj. paricita (f. tA): v. Accustomed, practised.
WONTED , a. AByAsikaH -kI -kaM, vyAvahArikaH &c. See CUSTOMARY.
Woo, s. (vivAhArTaM) yAc 1 A, arT 10 A. ArAD c. [Woo]er, s. vivAhakAmaH, vivAhArTin m.
WOO: yAcate (yAca, c. 1.), Vi. i. 59.: v. To beg, solicit.
To WOO , v. a. vivAhArTaM yAc (c. 1. yAcati -cituM) or prArT (c. 10. -arTayati -te -yituM), vivAhArTaM ArAD or cittArADanaM kf.

Wood, s. kAzWaM, dAru n. 2 vanaM, araRyaM; See Forest; ‘w(ood)-apple’ kapitTaH, ‘w(ood)-cock’ kAzWa-vana-kukkuwaH, ‘w(ood)-cutter’ kAzWacCid m., kAzWikaH, ‘w(ood)-land’ vfkza-vfkzAvfta-BUmi f., ‘w(ood)-man’ AwavikaH, vanajIvin m., ‘w(ood)-cutter’ q. v.; ‘w(ood)-nymph’ vanadevatA; ‘w(ood)-pecker’ kAzWakUwaH, dArvAGAwaH; ‘w(ood)-pigeon’ hArItaH; ‘w(ood)-sorrel’ cukrikA, daMtaSaWA. [Wood]ed, a. vfkzAvfta, savfkza. [Wood]en, a. kAzWa-dAru-maya (yI f.), kAzWa-dAru in comp. [Wood]y, vfkzAkIrRa, drumaBUyizWa, drumAvfta. 2 Silvan, q. v.

WOOD: I Of trees:(1) kAzWam, to cut w.: kAzWaM pAwayati, Mah. iii. 297. 2.; made of w. of trees: tarURAM kAzWErGawita (f. tA), V. m. 79. 39.; w. -cutter: kAzWikaH, K. s. vi. 43.;(2) dAru (n.), the enemy of Mura h s transformed himself into w.: dAruBUto murAriH, Ha. ii.;(3) by comp., with a pestle of catechu w.: KAdireRa musalena, D. vi.II Forest: q. v.: vanam, went to w.: prasTito vanam, Mah.
WOOD , s. (Forest) vanaM, araRyaM, vipinaM, kAnanaM, see FOREST. — (Substance of trees, timber) kAzWaM, dAruH m. -ru n.
WOOD-APPLE , s. (The tree) kapitTaH. — (The fruit) kapitTaM.
WOOD-COCK , s. vanakukkuwaH, araRyakukkuwaH, vfkzakukkuwaH.
WOOD-CUTTER , s. vfkzaCid m., vanaCid, CettA m. (ttf), sTARuCedaH.
WOOD-HOUSE , s. kAzWarakzaRasTAnaM, iDmasTAnaM, dAhyakAzWasTAnaM.
WOOD-LAND , s. vfkzAvftaBUmiH f., tarugulmAvftaBUmiH f. -BUH f.
WOOD-NYMPH: vanadevI and sim. comp.s.
WOOD-NYMPH , s. vanadevatA, vanadevI, araRyadevatA -devI.
WOOD-PECKER , s. dArvAGAwaH, dArvAGAtaH, kAzWakuwwaH, SatapatrakaH, SatacCadaH, BadranAmA m. (n), kuWAkuH m., kuWAruH m.
WOOD-PIGEON: vanakapotaH and sim. comp. s.
WOOD-PIGEON , s. hAritaH, hArItaH, vanapArAvataH, vanakapotaH.
WOOD-SORREL: (1) cukriBA;(2) cANgerI.
WOOD-SORREL , s. cANgerI, kucANgerI, cukrikA, dantaSaWA, amlI, amlalo- RikA, amlalolikA, ambazWA, calas n.
WOODCOCK: vanakukkuwaH, or kAzWakukkuwaH, Mat.
WOODED , a. vfkzAvftaH -tA -taM, tarugulmAvftaH &c., savfkzaH -kzA -kzaM.
WOODEN: (1) kAzWamaya (f. yI);(2) dArumaya (f. yI);(3) dArava (f. vI);(4) by comp.
WOODEN , a. kAzWamayaH -yI -yaM, dArumayaH &c., kAzWI -zWinI -zWi (n), kAzWaGawitaH -tA -taM, dAruGawitaH &c., dAravaH -vI -vaM, dArujaH -jA -jaM, aDidArvaH -rvI -rvaM, kAzWa in comp., dAru in comp.
WOODLAND: (1) vfkzaBUmiH;(2) vfkzAvftaBUmiH etc.
WOODMAN: I Forester: q. v.: Awavika (f. kI).II Wood-cutter: kAzWika (f. kI).
WOODMAN , s. vanacArI m., vanajIvI m., AwavikaH See FORESTER.
WOODPECKER: (1) kAzWakuwwaH;(2) dArvADAwaH (taH); SatapatrakaH.
WOODY: I Wooden: q. v.II Wooded: (1) vfkzAvfta (f. tA);(2) vfkzAkIrRa (f. rRA); (3) taruBUyizWa (f. zWA); and sim. comp.s.III Wild: q. v.: vanya (f. nyA).

WOODY , a. (Abounding with wood) bahuvfkzAvftaH -tA -taM, vfkzAkIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, pracuravfkzaH -kzA -kzaM, vArkzaH -rkzI -rkzaM. — (Ligneous) kAzWamayaH -yI -yaM. — (Silvan) AraRyakaH &c., see SILVAN.
WOOER: (1) vivAhArTin (f. RI);(2) vivAhakAma (f. mA); etc.
WOOER , s. vivAhArTaprArTakaH, vivAhArTayAcakaH, stryupAsakaH.
Woof, s. pratitaMtraH, vARi-RI f.
WOOF: pratitantraH, yaTA ekenEva tantunA tAnapratitantrO BavataH, V. d. ii. 24.
WOOF , s. (In weaving) vARiH -RI f.
WOOING , s. vivAhArTaM prArTanaM, vivAhArTaM cittArADanaM.
Wool, s. lo(ro)man n., UrRA (of sheep). [Wool]len, a. lomaja, OrRa (RI f.), UrRAmaya (yI f.); mezalomaja; ‘w(oollen) cloth’ OrRa-vastraM-pawaH. [Wool]ly, a. lomaSa, romavat.
WOOL: (1) lo(ro)man (n.);(2) UrRA (properly of sheep);(3) by comp.; made of sheep's w., rat's w. and dog's w.: OrRAn vElAn vArzadaMSAn, Mah. ii. 51. 3.
WOOL , s. UrRA, mezaloma n. (n), aviloma n., mezaroma n., mezANgaruhaM, aNgaruhaM.
