WOOL(L)EN: (1) UrRAmaya (f. yI), w. marriage- string: UrRAmayaM kOtukahastasUtram, Ku. vii. 25.;(2) OrRa (f. rRI), w. and silken fabrics: orRaYca rANkavaYcEva pawwajaM kIwajaM taTA, Mah. ii. 51. 26.;(3) lo(ro)manirmita (f. tA), M. n.;(4) lo(ro)maja (f. jA), Nil.

WOOLLEN , a. OrRaH -rRI -rRaM, OrRakaH -kI -kaM, UrRAmayaH -yI -yaM, meza- lomamayaH -yI -yaM, mezalomanirmmitaH -tA -taM, mezalomajaH -jA -jaM, AvikaH -kI -kaM, rANkavaH -vI -vaM, mfgaromajaH &c.; ‘woollen cloth,’ OrRa- vastraM, OrRapawaH, avipawaH, AvikaH, OraBraM, jAlikA; ‘garment,’ OrRavAsas n., bAlavAsas n.
WOOLLY: I Lit.: lo(ro)maSa (f. SA).II W. -like: UrRABa (f. BA).
WOOLLY , a. lomaSaH -SA -SaM, romaSaH &c., romavAn -vatI -vat (t), lomavAn &c., UrRAsadfSaH -SI -SaM; ‘woolly hair,’ varvvaraH, varvva- rIkaH, carcarI.

Word, s. SabdaH, nAman n., padaM, vAcakaH; ‘w(ord) for w(ord)’ yaTASabdaM. 2 vacanaM, saMgaraH, pratijYA; See Promise; ‘true to, or keeping, oneʼs w(ord)’ satya-pAlita-saMgaraH; ‘you have given your w(ord)’ vihitapratijYaH-dattavacanaH-asi; ‘to break oneʼs w(ord)’ visaM-vad 1 P, pratijYAM lup c. 3 vAkyaM, vacas n., vAc f., ukti f., vacanaM; ‘whose w(ord) can be trusted’ AptaH, AptavAk; yaTArTavaktA; ‘war of w(ord)s’ vAgyudDaM, vAkkalahaH; ‘a man of few w(ord)s’ mitavAk, alpaBAzI. 4 saMdeSaH, vArtA; ‘in a w(ord)’ kiM bahunA; ‘in a few w(ord)s’ samAsataH, samAsena; ‘upon my w(ord)’ (I tell you &c.) yadi madvacaH SradDeyaM manyase, yadi te madvacane viSvAsaH. v. t. SabdAn rac 10 or yuj 10 or graMT 9 P; gen. ex. by (s.); ‘a briefly w(ord)ed message’ laGusaMdeSapadA sarasvatI; ‘well-w(ord)ed’ samyaggraTita, sADuvinyastaSabda; ‘pathetically w(ord)ed’ karuRArTagraTita (saMdeSa &c.). Wordy, a. bahuSabda, vistIrRavAc, bahuvANmaya (yI f.), upacitavAk. [Word]iness, s. Sabda-vAkya-vistaraH, vAgupacayaH, bahuSabdatvaM.

WORD (subs.): I Lit.:(1) SabdaH, low w.: apaSabdaH;(2) nAman (n. = name), of primitive, derivative and compound w. s: ruQayOgikamiSrARAM nAmnAm, H. c.;(3) padam (= formed word), here the w. paSu: atra paSupadam, Kav. viii.II In plu.: saying: q. v.: vacas (n.) or vAc (f.), by the haughty w. s: vacoBirudDatEH, Ki. xiv. 1.; one whose w. s can be trusted: AptavAc (mfn.); Sa. v. 27. Ph.: a man of few w. s: mitaBAzin (f. RI), R. i. 7.III Promise: q. v.:(1) vAkyam;(2) vacanam.IV Tidings, news: q. v.: sandeSaH. Ph.: in a word: kiM bahunA; in a few words:(1) samAsataH;(2) samAsena.
WORD (v.): simply w. ed: viSadaSabdavinyasta (f. stA); well-w.: samyaggraTita (f. tA): v. To express, declare.

WORD , s. (Single component part of a sentence) SabdaH, padaM, vAcakaH, varRAtmA m. (n), vAkyaM; ‘word for word,’ yaTASabdaM; ‘force of a word,’ SabdaSaktiH f., nirUQaH; ‘sense,’ SabdArTaH; ‘acceptation,’ SabdAnuSAsanaM; ‘low word,’ apaSabdaH, avAkzaraM; ‘radical form of a word,’ prakftiH f. — (Discourse, language) uktiH f., vAkyaM, vacanaM, vAk f. (c), vacas n.; ‘mere words,’ vANmAtraM; ‘bad words,’ duruktiH f., durvAkyaM, durvacanaM; ‘waste of words,’ vAgvyayaH; ‘war of words,’ vAgyudDaM; ‘a word in sea- son,’ prAptakAlavacanaM; ‘a man of few words,’ alpaBAzI m. (n), mitaBAzI m., mitavAk m., vAgdaridraH. — (Promise) vacanaM, pratijYA; ‘to break one's word,’ visaMvad, see PROMISE. — (Tidings) samAcAraH, saMvAdaH, sandeSaH. — (In a word) samAsatas.
To WORD , v. a. SabdadvArA vyAKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), Sabdato vyAKyA, SabdaracanAM kf, SabdayojanAM kf, SabdavinyAsaM kf.
WORDINESS , s. SabdavistAraH, SabdabAhulyaM, bahuSabdatvaM.
WORDY: (1) bahuSabda (f. bdA), -ka (f. kA);(2) vistIrRavAc (mfn.); etc.
WORDY , a. bahuSabdakaH -kA -kaM, SAbdikaH -kI -kaM, SAbdaH -bdI -bdaM, bahuvANmayaH -yI -yaM, vAgmI -gminI -gmi (n).

Work, s. karman n., kfti f., kAryaM, vyApAraH, vyavasAyaH, niyogaH; kriyA. 2 Labour, q. v., udyamaH, udyogaH. 3 graMTaH, kriyA, kftiH; ‘at w(ork)’ karmavyagra a., kAryavyApfta a.; ‘had hard w(ork) to go’ gacCannatIvAyAsitaH; ‘w(ork)house’ karmaSAlA; ‘w(ork)shop’ karma-Silpa-udyoga-SAlA. v. i. pariSramaM-karma-kf 8 U, vyA-pf 6 A (with loc.), kAryAsakta, kAryavyApfta a. BU 1 P, pari-, Sram 4 P, udyam 1 P, 2 Pal 1 P, guRaM Avah 1 P or dA 3 U, oft. by guRaH; ativIryavatIva Bezaje bahuralpIyasi dfSyate guRaH (Ki. ii. 4) ‘w(ork)s well or efficaciously’. v. t. saM-, cal c., sf c. 2 kf 8 U, vi-DA 3 U, nirmA 3 A, 2 P, rac 10, Gaw c., (Gawayati), kxp c. 3 utpad c., jan c., Avah. 4 Ayas c., pari-Sram c., kliS c. 5 Manage, q. v.; ‘w(ork) out’ pari-upa-kxp c., sAD 5 P or c.; ‘w(ork) up’, Excite, q. v.; upa-pra-yuj 7 A, 10. [Work]ing, s. cezwA, vyApAraH, pravftti f., kriyA; See (s.). Wrought, a. kfta, vihita &c. 2 saMskfta, parizkfta, kfta; ‘w(rought) gold’ kftahema; ‘w(rought) iron’ kuSI. Workman, s. karmakaraH (rI f.), karmakAraH, karmakArin, kAruH, SilpakAraH. [Workman]-like, a. dakza, karmaWa. [Workman]ship, s. karmakOSalaM, hastakriyA. 2 karma, nirmARaM, GawanA, AkftiH.

WORK (subs.): (1) karman (n.: in every sense), to leave w.: karma tyajati, Y.; who commencing a w.: karmAramBaM tu yaH kftvA, Mit.; driver's w.: yantfkarma, Si. xvii. 35.;(2) kriyA, this w. of Kālidāsa: kriyAmimAM kAlidAsasya, V. i. 2.; obstruction to religious w. s: DarmakriyAviGnaH, Sa. v. 15.;(3) kAryam, in this important w.: kArye guruRi, Ku. iii. 13.;(4) kftiH (rare), in a w. of Kālidāsa: kAlidAsasya kftO, Mal. i.: v. Also occupation, labour, deed.

WORK (v. i.): I To labour: q. v.: karma or kArya karoti, you do not w.: na karma karozi, D. vi.; will w. like w.-men: karma karmakaravat karizyati, Si. [Page767] II To operate: q. v.:(1) PalaM dadAti (dA, c. 3.);(2) expr. with guRaH.
WORK (v. t.): I To manufacture, make: q. v.: karoti.II To make w.: karma kArayatiH v. Also to toil.III To move (as a ma- -chine): q. v.: cAlayati (c. of cal).IV To embroider: q. v.

To WORK , v. n. (Labor, make exertion) Sram (c. 4. SrAmyati, SramituM), pariSram, SramaM kf, udyogaM kf, udyamaM kf, utsAhaM kf, yatnaM kf, vyavasAyaM kf, karmma kf, Ayas (c. 4. -yasyati -situM), AyAsaM kf, yat, cezw, vyavaso, udyasa. — (Operate, act) kf, cezw, Palam utpad, praBU, see To OPERATE.

To WORK , v. a. (Move, cause to move) cal (c. 10. cAlayati -yituM), saMcal, saMcar (c. 10. -cArayati -yituM), sf in caus. — (Form by labour) kf, Gaw (c. 10. Gawayati -yituM), nirmA, rac, viDA, kxp, see To MAKE, MANUFACTURE. — (Produce, bring about) utpad (c. 10. -pAdayati -yituM), sampada, jan (c. 10. janayati -yituM), sAD, kf. — (Cause to labour) Ayas (c. 10. -yAsayati -yituM), kliS (c. 10. kleSayati -yituM), Sram (c. 10. Sramayati -yituM), sad (c. 10. sAdayati -yituM), ava- sad. — (Manage) praRI, nI, niyam, vah in caus., nirvah. — (Em- broider), see the word.

WORK , s. (Employment) karmma n. (n), vyApAraH, kAryyaM, vyavasAyaH, see OCCUPATION; ‘a laborious work,’ Sramakarmma n. — (Labour, exertion) SramaH, AyAsaH, kleSaH, udyogaH, utsAhaH, udyamaH, yatnaH, [Page845-b+ 51] kazwaM. — (That which is done of made) karmma n. (n), kAryyaM kriyA, kftiH f., kftyaM. — (Composition, work of an author) granTaH, kriyA, kftiH f. — (Religious act) karmma n. (n), kriyA anu- zWAnaM; ‘good works,’ satkarmma n., satkriyA, sukarmma n., puRyakarmma n., DarmmakAryyaM, DarmmakftyaM, puRyaM, sADanaM; ‘way of salvation by works,’ karmmamArgaH; ‘one who seeks salvation by work,’ karmmamArgo (n), DUmapaTaH, DUmraDIH m.; ‘rich in good works,’ puRyapuYjaH, ‘reward of them,’ puRyaPalaM; ‘abandonment of them,’ karmma- tyAgaH. — (Needle-work), see EMBROIDERY, NEEDLE-WORK.
WORK OUT: I To accomplish: q. v.: nizpA- dayati (c. of pad).II To invent: parikalpayati (c. of kxp).III To efface: q. v.
WORK UP: I To raise: q. v.II To employ, use: prayuMkte (yuj, c. 7.).
WORK-HOUSE , s. karmmaSAlA, karmmagfhaM, daridrAlayaH.
WORK-MAN , s. karmmakaraH, karmmakAraH, karmmAraH, kAruH m., SilpakAraH
WORK-WOMAN , s. karmmakArI -riRI, karmmakarI, SilpakArI.
WORKHOUSE: *karmAgAram, anATASramaH (= asylum).
WORKING (subs.): (1) kAryapraRAlI (?);(2) pari- RAmaH (= result, fruit).
WORKING , s. (Act of labouring) udyogakaraRaM, utsAhakaraRaM, karmma- karaRaM, AyAsakaraRaM, SramakaraRaM. — (Operation) cezwA.
WORKMAN, WORKWOMAN: (1) karmakaraH (f. rI); (2) karmakAraH (f. rI);(3) karmakArin (f. RI); (4) SilpakAraH (f. rI = artisan).
WORKMANLIKE: (1) karmaWa (f. WA);(2) dakza (f. kzA = skilful: q. v.).
WORKMANSHIP: I Skill: karmakOSalam and sim. comp.sII = work:(1) karman (n.);(2) nirmARam (= manufacture).
WORKMANSHIP , s. GawanA, nirmmARaM, racanA, viracanA, AkftiH f.
WORKSHOP: (1) karmaSAlA (?);(2) SilpaSAlA; (3) AveSanam, pra-.
WORKSHOP , s. SilpaSAlA, SilpagfhaM, AveSanaM, prAveSanaM.

World, s. viSvaM, jagat n., BuvanaM, lokaH, carAcaraM, trivizwapaM, aKilaM jagat, brahmAMqaM; ‘three w(orld)s’ triBuvanaM, trilokI, trElokyaM. 2 Earth, q. v.; ‘end of the w(orld)’ kalpAMtaH. 3 lokaH, janaH, (pl. also). 4 saMsAraH, BavaH, saMsfti f., prapaMcaH, jIvayAtrA. 5 lokAcAraH-mArgaH, janarIti f., rUQi f., lOkikaM, lokaH; ‘in this w(orld)’ iha; ‘in the next w(orld)’ aButra, paratra, pretya ‘the next world’ para-preta-lokaH, lokAMtaraM; ‘of this w(orld)’ Ehika; ‘of the next w(orld)’ pAratrika-Amuzmika-pAralOkika- (kI f.); ‘you are my all the w(orld)’ tvaM mama jIvita-sarvasvIBUtaH; ‘renounce the w(orld)’ saMnyas 4 P, vErAgyaM Baj 1 U; ‘aversion to w(orld)’; vErAgyaM; ‘knowing the ways of the w(orld)’ lOkikajYa (S. 4); ‘snares of the w(orld)’ mohapASaH, mAyAjAlaM-cakraM. Worldly, a. lOkika; ‘w(orldly) sages’ lOkikAH sADavaH; (s.) in comp.; ‘w(orldly) tie’ saMsArataMtuH-nibaMDanaM, BavapASaH. 2 Ehika, sAMsArika, EhalOkika, prApaMcika. 3 (‘W(orldly)-minded’), Ehika-dfzwi-budDi, saMsAranizwa, vizayAsaktacitta, prapaMcAsakta; ‘w(orldly) wise’ saMsArajYAnin; ‘w(orldly) wisdom’ saMsArajYAnaM, vyavahArajYAnaM. [Worldl]iness, s. saMsAranizWA, prapaMca-vizaya-Asakti f. Worldling, s. See Sensualist.

WORLD: Lit.: (1) viSvam (= universe), of w. wide reputation: viSvaviKyAtakIrtiH, D. s.; con- ducive to the good of the w.: viSvajanInaH (nA, naM) Si. i. 41.; supporter of the w.: viSvamBaraH, Si. i. 38.; (2) jagat (= the whole w., also particular w.- s), the w. is now an empty withered wilderness: SUnyamaDunA jIrRAraRyaM jagat, U. i.; the whole w. from God to worm: Abrahma kIwAntamidaM samastaM jagat, V. m. 74. 20.;(3) lokaH (any w.), the w. of gods: amaralokaH, Ve. vii.; has left the w. (i. e. died): paralokamito gataH, Ve. iii. 15.;(4) Buvanam (= 3), the three w. s robbed of their jewel: pari- muzitaratna triBuvanam, Ma. v. 29.;(5) saMsAraH (= living w.), throughout the w.: yAvatsaMsAramaRqalam, Si.;(6) BUH (= earth: q. v.). Ph.: in this w.: iha: v. Here; of this w.: EhikaH (kI, kam); of the next w. pAratrika (f. kI) or Amuzmika (f. kI), D. ii.II People: q. v.: lokaH.III Mundane w.: saMsAraH, snares of the w.: saMsAramAyA (also sim. mAyAjAlam, mohapASaH, etc.). To renounce the w.: saMnyasyati (as, c. 4.); aversion to w.: vErAgyam.

WORLD , s. (Universe) jagat n., jagatI, lokaH, carAcaraM, see UNIVERSE. — (The earth) lokaH, BuvanaM, pfTivI, BUH f., BavaH, BUlokaH, BUgolaH, jagat n., jIvADAraH, jIvAjIvADAraH, vizwapaM, pizwapaM; ‘creator of the world,’ jagatsrazwA m. (zwf); ‘destruction of the world,’ jagatkzayaH, jagadvinASaH; ‘destroyer of it,’ jagadGAtI m.; ‘end of the world,’ jagadantaH, kalpaH, BavavItiH f.; ‘to the end of the world,’ AkalpAt; ‘ends of the world,’ digantAH m. pl.; ‘the three worlds,’ triBuvanaM, trElokyaM, lokatrayaM, BuvanatrayaM, jagattrayaM; ‘soul of the world,’ jagadAtmA m., lokAtmA m. — (Mundane existence) saMsAraH, saMsaraRaM, saMsftiH f., ihalokavAsaH, BUlokavAsaH, jagannivAsaH, prapaYcaH, kazwakArakaH, saMsAramArgaH, saMsAracakraM, saMmArAvarttaH, mohAspadaM, mAyAcakraM, mAyAjAlaM, vizayajAlaM, lokayAtrA, pravfttimArgaH; ‘this world,’ ihalokaH; ‘the next world,’ paralokaH, lokAntaraM, pretalokaH; ‘the world above,’ UrdDvalokaH; ‘belonging to this world,’ EhalOkikaH -kI -kaM, EhikaH &c.; ‘belonging to the next world,’ pAralOkikaH -kI -kaM, pAratrikaH &c., AmuzmikaH &c.; ‘in this world,’ iha, ihaloke; ‘in the next world,’ paratra, amutra, pretya; ‘renunciation of the world,’ sannyasanaM, sarvvasaNgapari- tyAgaH; ‘one who renounces it,’ sannyAsI m. (n); ‘deadness to the world,’ vErAgyaM, vizayaviraktiH f.; ‘sick of the world,’ BavarogI -giRI &c., BavArttaH -rttA -rttaM; ‘snares of the world,’ mohajAlaM, mAyAjAlaM, mohapASaH. — (Mankind) lokaH, lokAH m. pl., jIvalokaH, janAH m. pl.; ‘fear of the world,’ lokalajjA — (Customs of men) lokamArgaH, lokarItiH f., lokapracAraH, janarI- tiH f., janapracAraH, ‘one who has seen the world,’ bahudfzwaH.
WORLDLINESS , s. lOkikatA, vizayAsaktiH f., prapaYcAsaktiH dehABimAnaM.
WORLDLING , vizayI m. (n), prapaYcAsaktaH. See WORLDLY.

WORLDLY: I Lit.:(1) EhikaH (kI, kaM); (2) sAMsArika (f. kI);(3) EhalOkikaH (kI, kaM);(4) by comp.II Devoted to world: (1) vizayAsakta (f. ktA), w.-minded: vizayAsaktacetas, (mfn.) and sim. comp.s;(2) saMsAranizWa (f. zWA) and sim. comp. s (?).

WORLDLY , a. (Pertaining to this world) lOkikaH -kI -kaM, sAMsA- rikaH -kI -kaM, EhikaH &c., EhalOkikaH &c., prApaYcikaH &c., dfzwArTaH -rTA -rTaM, saMsArI -riRI -ri (n), lOkyaH -kyA -kyaM. — (Devoted to it) vizayAsaktaH -ktA -ktaM, vizayADInaH -nA -naM, prapaYcAsaktaH -ktA -ktaM, ihalokanizWaH -zWA -zWaM, ihalokAsaktaH &c., saMsAranizWaH &c., saMsArE kanizWaH &c.
WORLDLY-MINDED , a. EhikabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, EhikadfzwiH -zwiH -zwi, ihalokadfzwiH &c., prapaYcabudDiH &c., saMsArEkalakzaH -kzA -kzaM.
WORLDLY-WISDOM , s. sAMsArikajYAnaM, saMsArajYAnaM, vyavahArajYAnaM.
WORLDLY-WISE , a. saMsArajYAnI -ninI -ni (n), vyavahArajYAnI &c.

Worm, s. kf(kri)miH (in the stomach also), kIwaH-wakaH; ‘w(orm)-disease’ kfmirogaH; ‘destroying w(orm)s’ kfmihara, kfmiGna. [Worm]y, a. kfmila, kfmimaya (yI f.), kfmikula-cita. 2 kfmiBakzita-nizkuzita.

WORM: I The animal:(1) kIwaH, w.-eaten: kIwErvidDa (f. dDA), V. m. 79. 87.;(2) kf(kri)BiH, of w. s, insects, and butterflies: kfmikIwapataNgAnAm, M. xii. 56.II Of the stomach: kf(kri)miH, destroying w. s: kfmiGna (f. GnA), Bha.

WORM , s. kfmiH m., krimiH m., kIwaH -wakaH, gaRqUpadaH -dI, kiYculukaH, mahIlatA, SilI, BUlatA, KarjjUH f., kIkasaH, taRqurIRaH, kfpaRaH. — (In the inside of the body) kfmiH m., krimiH m., mIvA, antrAdaH, lelihaH; ‘the disease,’ kfmirogaH; ‘affected by it,’ kfmI -miRI -mi (n); ‘destroying worms,’ kfmiGnaH -GnI -GnaM, kfmiharaH -rA -raM; ‘having them,’ kfmilaH -lA -laM.
WORM-EATEN , a. kfmiKAditaH -tA -taM, kfmiBakzitaH &c., kfminizkuzitaH &c.
WORMY: (1) kfmila (f. lA);(2) kfmin (f. RI); (3) kfmimaya (f. yI); etc.
WORMY , a. kfmilaH -lA -laM, kfmI -miRI &c., kfmimayaH -yI -yaM.

WORN , p. p. DftaH -tA -taM, DAritaH &c., BftaH -tA -taM, parihitaH &c.; ‘is worn,’ DAryyate, Briyate. — (Worn away) GarzitaH -tA -taM, mfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, unmfzwaH &c., AGawwitaH &c. — (Worn out, decayed) jIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, jarjaraH -rA -raM, jarjarIkaH -kA -kaM, jaraWaH -WA -WaM. — (Worn out, fatigued) SrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, see FATIGUED.
Worry, v. t. pra-, bAD 1 A, ard 1 P or c., Ayas c., kliS c., pIq 10, pra-hf 1 P.
WORRY: (1) bADate, pra-, saM-, vi-, (bAD, c. 1.); (2) kliSnAti (kliS, c. 9.): v. To trouble.
To WORRY , v. a. bAD, kliS, vyaT, Ayas. See To TEASE.

Worse, a. nikfzwatara, aDikaduzwa, pApIyas, duzwa-Kala-tara. 2 aDikarugRa, or by vfD 1 A; ‘she is getting w(orse) day by day’ anu-divasaM tasyA viparyayo dfSyate or tasyA vikAro varDate eva; ‘you are none the w(orse) for it’ na tarhi prAgavasTAyAH parihIyase (Mal. 4). adv. ku, duzwatayA; ex. by (a.)
WORSE: I In gen.:(1) aDikaduzwa (f. zwA = more faulty);(2) nikfzwatara (f. rA = more low); (3) pApIyas (f. sI = more wicked; etc.)II In health: aDikarugRa (f. gRA) etc.: v.III sick.
WORSE (adv.): (1) nikfzwataram;(2) pApIyas (n.); etc.: v. Above.

WORSE , a. duzwataraH -rA -raM, kazwataraH &c., KalataraH &c., aDikaduzwaH -zwA -zwaM, pApIyAn -yasI -yas (s), viSepaduzwaH &c., garIyAn &c., anuttamaH -mA -maM; ‘better and worse,’ parAparaH -rA -raM. — (More sick) aDikarogI -giRI &c.
WORSE , adv. duzwataraM, kazwataraM, KalataraM, aDikaduzwaM, pApIyas.

Worship, v. t. pUj 10, upAs 2 A, upasTA 1 A, aBi-, arc 1 P, 10, A-rAD c., Baj 1 U, sev 1 A, namasyati (D.). s. pUjA, upAsanA-naM, arcA, arcanaM-nA, ArADanaM, namasyA, saparyA, apaciti f., arhaRA. 2 (As a title) devaH, mahArAjaH. [Worship]per, s. pUjakaH, arcakaH, upAsakaH, BaktaH, -janaH, ArADakaH, sevakaH; ‘w(orshipper) of Siva’ SEvaH; ‘w(orshipper) of Vishnu’ vEzRavaH.
WORSHIP (subs.): (1) upAsanam, -nA;(2) pUjA, -janam;(3) arcanA, -nam, aBi-. Ph.: Your w. (in address): devaH or DarmAvatAraH.

WORSHIP (v.): (1) upAste, (As, c. 2.), who w. s other gods: yo'nyAM devatAmupAste, San. iv.; (2) pUjayati (pUj, c. 10.), I will describe how to w. Śiva: SivapUjAM pravakzyAmi, A. p.: v. Also to honour, serve.

WORSHIP , s. pUjA, pUjanaM, BajanaM, BaktiH f., arcA, arcanaM -nA, aByarcA -rcanaM, samaByarcanaM, upAsanA, upAsA, upAstiH f., upacaryyA, sevA, A- rADanaM -nA, namasyA, saparyyA, arhaRaM -RA, ijyA, namaskAraH, apacitiH f.; ‘of the gods,’ devapUjA, devaBaktiH f., devatArcanaM. — (Your worship) BagavAn m. (t), BavAn m.

To WORSHIP , v. a. pUj (c. 10. pUjayati -yituM), aBipUj, sampUj, arc (c. 1. arcati -rcituM, c. 10. arcayati -yituM), aByarc, samarc, samaByarc, Baj (c. 1. Bajate, BaktuM), upAs (c. 2. -Aste -situM), ArAD (c. 10. -rADayati -yituM), sev (c. 1. sevate -vituM, c. 10. sevayati -yituM), namas (nom. namasyati), saBAj (c. 10. saBAjayati -yituM), mah, Sru in des., arh; ‘by sacrifice,’ yaj (c. 1. yajati, yazwuM, IjituM).
WORSHIPFUL: (1) arcanIya (f. yA), aBi, samaBi-; (2) pUjya (f. jyA) or pUjanIya (f. yA);(3) upAsya (f. syA) or upAsanIya (f. yA); etc.

WORSHIPFUL , a. pUjArhaH -rhA -rhaM, pUjanIyaH -yA -yaM, arcanIyaH &c., BawwAraH -rA -raM, BawwArakaH &c., namasyaH -syA -syaM, upAsyaH -syA -syaM, aBIjyaH &c., BAvamiSraH -SrA -SraM, arGyaH &c. See HONOURABLE.
WORSHIPPED , p. p. pUjitaH -tA -taM, arcitaH &c., samaByarcitaH &c., aYcitaH &c., namasyitaH &c., namasitaH &c., upAsitaH &c. See HONOURED.

WORSHIPPER: (1) upAsaka (f. sikA);(2) pUjaka (f. jikA); idol-w.: pratimApUjakaH;(3) by comp., w. of Energy: SAktaH; w. of Viṣṇu: vEzRavaH;(4) Bakta (f. ktA = attached to); w. of Gaṇeśa: gaReSaBaktaH; w. of Yama: yamaparAyaRaH, San. 34.
WORSHIPPER , s. pUjakaH, arcakaH, upAsakaH, upAsitA m. (tf), sevakaH, sevitA m. (tf), ArADakaH, BajakaH, pUjAkArI m. (n).
Worst, a. duzwatama, pApizWa, nikfzwatama, kazwatama. s. kazwatamAvasTA, kazwatamo BAgaH. v. t. Humble, Subdue, q. v.

WORST: I Adj.:I(1) duzwatama (f. mA = very faulty);(2) pApizWa (f. zWA = very wicked); (3) kazwatama (f. mA = very distressing);(4) atinikfzwa (f. zwA = very bad); etc.II Adv.: expr. by adj. or comp.III Subs.: kazwatamA daSA and sim. expr. s.
WORST (v.): parABavati (BU, c. 1.): v. To de- -feat, overthowoverthrow.
WORST , a. duzwatamaH -mA -maM, kazwatamaH -mA -maM, pApizWaH -zWA -zWaM, sarvvapApizWaH &c., KalatamaH -mA -maM, garizWaH -zWA -zWaM.
WORST , s. (Most evil state) duzwatamadaSA, kazwatamadaSA.
To WORST , v. a. aBiBU, parABU, parAji (c. 1. -jayati -jetuM), ji.
Worsted, s. OrRasUtraM-taMtuH.
WORSTED (subs.): (1) OrRasUtram (?);(2) UrRAtantuH (?); etc.
WORSTED , s. OrRasUtraM, OrRatantuH m., UrRAmayasUtraM.
WORT: latAviSeze navasurAyAYca.

Worth, s. arGaH-rGaM, mUlyaM; See Value. 2 guRaH, utkarzaH, sAravattA. a. arGa, mUlya, arha in comp.; ex. by pot. pass. part. or arh 1 P; ‘w(orth) considering’ vicArArha, vicAramarhati, vicArya; ‘w(orth) much’ bahumUlya; ‘w(orth) little’ alpArGa; ‘w(orth) while’ sAMprata, ucita, SramArha. [Worth]less, a. nirguRa, guRahIna, nirarTaka, asAra, akiMcitkara (rI f.), sAra-guRa-hIna, alpamUlya, tfRaprAya, aDama, kutsita; See Mean; oft. by a in comp.; adravyaM, apAtraM ‘a w(orthless) object’. Worthy, a. yogya, ucita, arha, sadfSa, anurUpa, or by pot. pass. part. or arh; ‘a pupil w(orthy) of the name’ paramArTataH yaH SizyaH, yaH SizyanAmArhaH; ‘having a husband w(orthy) of her’ anurUpaBartfgAminI (S.); ‘a w(orthy) object’ pAtraM, satpAtraM, guRAspadaM. 2 Arya, mAnya, pUjya, Bagavat. 3 guRin, guRavat, guRopeta. s. mAnyajanaH, AryaH, janaH, sajjanaH. [Worth]ily, adv. yogyatayA, ucitaM, yaTArTaM, upapannaM. [Worth]iness, s. yogyatA, arhatA, guRaH, pAtratA.
WORTH (subs.): I Value, price: q. v.: arDaH. II Excellence, virtue: q. v.: guRaH.
WORTH (adj.): expr. by comp., what is it w.: kiMmUlyamidam; w. much: bahumUlya (f. lyA); w. little: alpArGa (f. rGA); w. while: sAmpratam.
WORTH , s. (Valuc) arGaH, mUlyaM, sAratA, arTaH, see VALUE; ‘of little worth,’ alpamUlyaH -lyA -lyaM, alyArGaH -rGA -rGaM, apArTaH -rTA -rTaM. — (Excellence) sAratvaM, guRaH, guRatA, mAnyatA.

WORTH , a. mUlya in comp., arGa in comp., arhaH -rhA -rhaM, upayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, yogyaH -gyA -gyaM; ‘worth much,’ bahumUlyaH -lyA -lyaM; ‘worth little,’ alpamUlyaH &c.; ‘how much is this worth?’ kimmUlyam etat; ‘worth while,’ SramArhaH -rhA -rhaM, SramayogyaH -gyA -gyaM, see WHILE.
WORTHILY: (1) yogyatayA;(2) by adj. or cir- -cumlo.
WORTHILY , adv. yogyaM, yuktaM, uyayuktaM. See PROPERLY, RIGHTLY.
WORTHINESS: (1) yogyatA, -tvam;(2) upayuktatA, -tvam;(3) arhatA, -tvam.
WORTHINESS , s. yogyatA, upayuktatA, yuktatA, arhatA, pAtratA, saguRatvaM.

WORTHLESS: (1) nirguRa (f. RA), guRahIna (f. nA), and sim. comp. s (= without any virtue); (2) asAra (f. rA), akiYcitkara (f. rI), etc. (= good-for-nothing);(3) a- (=not) in comp., w. object: apAtram, Mu.; w. thing: adravyam, Ku.

WORTHLESS , a. nirguRaH -RA -RaM, guRahInaH -nA -naM, guRarahitaH -tA -taM nirguRI -RinI -Ri (n), viguRaH -RA -RaM, asAraH -rA -raM, niHsAra &c., sArahInaH -nA -naM, tfRaprAyaH -yA -yaM, aDamaH -mA -maM, apramUlya -lyA -lyaM, apraSastaH -stA -staM; ‘of worthless character,’ aguRa SIlaH -lA -laM; ‘a worthless object,’ niHsAradravyaM, adravyaM, apAtraM
WORTHLESSNESS: (1) nirguRatA, -tvam; asAratA, -tvam; etc.: v. Above.
WORTHLESSNESS , s. nirguRatvaM, guRahInatA, vEguRyaM, asAratA, niHsAratA.
WORTHY: Adj.: yogya (f. gyA): v. Deserv- -ing, fit. To be w. of: arhati (arh, c. 1.): v. To deserve,-ing of. II Subs.: mAnyajanaH and sim. comp. s.

WORTHY , a. (Deserving) arhaH -rhA -rhaM, yogyaH -gyA -gyaM, upayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, ucitaH -tA -taM, samucitaH &c., sadfSaH -SI -SaM, anurUpaH -pA -paM, or expressed by the fut. pass. part.; ‘worthy of death,’ maraRArhaH -rhA -rhaM, maraRocitaH -tA -taM, baDArhaH &c., baDyaH -DyA -DyaM; ‘worthy of honour,’ mAnArhaH &c., mAnyaH -nyA -nyaM; ‘of praise,’ SlAGyaH -GyA -GyaM; ‘worthy to be called,’ KyAtavyaH -vyA -vyaM; ‘possessing a husband worthy of her,’ anurUpaBarttfBA- -ginI; ‘to be worthy,’ arh (c. 1. arhati -rhituM), see To DE- SERVE; ‘a worthy object or person,’ pAtraM, satpAtraM, BAjanaM, guRapAtraM, guRaBAjanaM. — (Possessing worth or excellence) AryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, guRI -RinI -Ri (n), guRavAn -vatI -vat (t), mAnyaH -nyA -nyaM, aDiguRaH -RA -RaM, BadrakaH -kA -kaM.
WORTHY , s. (Man of worth) AryyajanaH, sajjanaH, mAnapAtraM.

Wound, s. vraRaH, kzataM, kzati f.; aruz n., IrmaM, AGAtaH, prahAraH; ‘a w(ound) in the flesh’ tvagvraRaH; ‘fresh w(ound)’ ArdrakzataM, sadyovraRaH. v. t. vyaT 4 P, kzaR 8 P, tud 6 P, A-aBi-han 2 U, kzi 5 P, vraR 10, Bid-Cid 7 P, vi-dF 9 P; See Offend, Hurt. [Wound]ed, a. kzata, vraRita, Binna, vidDa, Binnadeha; ‘greatly w(ounded)’ kzatavikzata; ‘mortally w(ounded)’ Binnamarman.
WOUND (subs.): (1) vraRa (mn.), w. s are of vari- ous shapes: nAnAkftayo vraRAH, Ni.;(2) kzatam: v. Hurt;(3) Irmam (rare).

WOUND (v.): (1) viDyati (vyaD, c. 4. = to pierce: q. v.);(2) hanti (han, c. 2. = to strike), w. ed with horns: vizARErhataH, Ni.;(3) kziRoti (kzi, c. 5.: rare), w. ed her deeply in the heart: imAM hfdi vyAyatapAtamakziRot, Ku. v. 54.;(4) tudati (tud, c. 6.): v. To hurt. W. ed:(1) kzata (f. tA), pari-, vi-;(2) vraRita (f. tA);(3) kftavraRa (f. RA) and sim. comp. s. Severly w. ed: kzatavikzata (f. tA). Mortally w.: Binnamarman (mfn.).
WOUND , s. (Injury to the flesh) vraRaH -RA -RaM, kzataM, kzatiH f., parikzataM, arus n., IrmmaM, veDaH -DanaM, prahAraH, AGAtaH, udGAtaH, astrAGAtaH, lUnakaH; ‘flesh-wound,’ tvagBedaH, tvakCedaH.

To WOUND , v. a. kzaR (c. 8. kzaRoti -RituM), parikzaR, vraR (c. 10. -vraRayati -yituM), vraRaM kf, kzataM kf, vyaD (c. 4. viDyati, vyadDuM), pari- vyaD, prativyaD, vraSc (c. 6. vfScati, vraScituM), pravraSc, Bid, Cid, vidF, riz, kzi, ard, jarjjarIkf. See To HURT.
WOUND , p. p. vezwitaH -tA -taM, parivezwitaH &c.; ‘wound up,’ upasaMhftaH &c.

WOUNDED , p. p. kzataH -tA -taM, parikzataH &c., vraRitaH &c., kftavraRaH -RA -RaM, vidDaH -dDA -dDaM, BinnaH -nnA -nnaM, BinnadehaH -hA -haM, astrAhataH -tA -taM, rizwaH -zwA -zwaM, jarjaritaH -tA -taM, jarjarIkftaH &c., jarjaraH -rA -raM; ‘mortally,’ BinnamarmmA -rmmA -rmma (n).

WOVE , WOVEN, p. p. UtaH -tA -taM, utaH &c., vyUtaH -tA -taM, vyutaH &c., otaH -tA -taM, syUtaH &c., tantrI -ntriRI -ntri (n), tantunirmmitaH -tA -taM, tAntavaH -vI -vaM, nirmmitaH -tA -taM; ‘wove cloth,’ tAntavadastraM, tantusantataM; ‘wove silk,’ dukUlaM, kzOmaM, kzomaM.
Wraith, s. piSAcaH, vetAlaH, BUtaH.
WRANGLE: kalahAyate (nomi.): v. To quarrel.
WRANGLING (subs.); kalahaH: v. Quarrel.

Wrap, v. t. A-vf 5 U, A-pari-vezw 1 A or c., ava-guMW 10, AcCad 10. [Wrap]ped, a. vezwita &c.; koSIkfta, koSasTa. [Wrap]per, s. prAvAraH, prAvaraRaM, avaguMWanaM, A-, vezwanaM, puwaH-waM, koSaH-zaH, AcCAdanaM, piDAnaM.
WRAP: avaguRWayati (guRW, c. 1.): v. To cover, envelop.

To WRAP . v. a. Avezw (c. 1. vezwate -zwituM, c. 10. -vezwayati -yituM), parivezw, ACad (c. 10. -CAdayati -yituM), pariCada, avaguRW (c. 10. -guRwayati -yituM), koSasTaM -sTAM kf, vAsanIkf; ‘I wrap myself up,’ AtmAnam avaguRwayAmi.
WRAPPED , p. p. vezwitaH -tA -taM, AvezwitaH &c., avaguRWitaH -tA -taM; ‘in an envelope,’ vAsanasTaH -sTA -sTaM, koSasTaH &c.
WRAPPER: (1) prAvAraH;(2) prAvaraRam;(3) bfhatikA (rare).
WRAPPER , s. vezwanaM, AvezwanaM, pracCadapawaH, prAvAraH, nicolaH, nivItaM, vAsanaM, puwaH, piDAnaM, caliH m., aMSukaH, nivftaH, vfhatikA.
WRATH: rozaH: v. Anger, rage.
WRATH , s. kroDaH, kopaH, rozaH, ruw f. (z), ruzwiH f. See ANGER
WRATHFUL: rozaRa (f. RA): v. Angry.
WRATHFUL , a. kopI -pinI &c., caRqaH -RqA -RqaM. See ANGRY.
WRATHFULLY: (1) sarozam, etc.;(2) by adj.: saMrabDa (f. bDA), etc.
Wreak, v. t. (revenge) siD c. sAD c. (sADayati), SuD c., niryat 10; ‘w(reak)ing revenge’ vErasADanaM-niryAtanaM; ‘w(reak) anger upon one’ kopasAMtvanaM kf, kroDaM Sam c.
WREAK: sADayati (c. of siD): v. To execute, satisfy.
To WREAK , v. a. kf, praRI, viDA. See To EXECUTE.

Wreath, s. mAlA, sraj f., mAlyaM, hAraH, utpIqaH, dAman f. n., Avali-lI f.; See Garland; ‘w(reath) of smoke’ DUmasya utpIqaH. Wreathe, v. t. graMT 9 P, sUtr 10, gu(guM)P 6 P, saM-dfB 6 P, 10. [Wreath]ed, a. sraganvita, mAlyavat, sUtrita.
WREATH: (1) mAlA;(2) mAlyam (flowery);(3) sraj (f. = 2).
WREATH , s. mAlA, mAlyaM, srak f. (sraj), hAraH, dAma n. (n), AvaliH -lI, see GARLAND; ‘of smoke,’ DUmAvalI -liH f.

WREATHE: I To string: q. v.: graTnAti (granT, c. 9.).II To encircle with a w.: w. d his neck: kaRWe guRaM niveSayAmAsa or AsaYjayAmAsa, R. vi. 83.; w. d: srajAnvita (f. tA), N. xv. 1.: v. To put, adorn.

To WREATHE , v. a. granT (c. 9. graTnAta, c. 1. granTati -nTituM, c. 10. granTayati -yituM), gumP (c. 1. gumPati -mPituM), guP (c. 1. guPati -PituM), gumPanaM kf, dfB (c. 10. darBayati -yituM), sandfB, mAlayA vezw.
Wreck, v. t. (nAvaM &c.) BaMj 7 P, naS c., ucCid 7 P, Bid 7 P. v. i. BaMj pass. s. potaBaMgaH, yAnaBaMgaH, nOvyasanaM. 2 BagnapotaH, BinnanOH. 3 ucCedaH, BaMgaH, nASaH.
WRECK (subs.): I Ship-w.: q. v.: potaBaNgaH and sim. comp. s.II The thing w. d:(1) BagnapotaH;(2) nazwanOkA, etc.III Ruin, des- -truction: q. v.: ucCedaH, sama-.
WRECK (v.): I Trans.:(1) Banakti (BaYj, c. 7. = to break: q. v.);(2) nASayati (c. of naS = destroy: q. v.).II Intrans.: Bajyate (pass. of BaYj).
WRECK , s. (Shipwreck) nOBaNgaH, nOvyasanaM. — (Wrecked ship) BagnanOkA, BinnanOkA, BinnanOH f., nazwanOkA, nazwanOH f., utkUlitanOH f.
To WRECK , v. a. nOBaNgaM kf, nOvyasanaM kf, nOkAnASaM kf, nAvaM BaYj or Bid or naS (c. 10. nASayati -yituM), utkUl (c. 10. -kUlayati -yituM).
WRECKED , p. p. BinnanOkaH -kA -kaM, BagnanOkaH &c., nazwanOkaH &c., utkUlitaH &c.
WREN: pakziviSezaH; svarRacUqaH.
Wrench, Wrest, v. t. saMpIqya grah 9 U, balAt Akfz 1 P or AcCid 7 P, apa-hf 1 P, AcCidya grah. s. balAdAkarzaRaM.
WRENCH: I Verb.: balAdAkarzati (kfz, c. 1. = to pull: q. v.) or AcCinatti (Cid, c. 7. = to carry off).II Subs.: balAdAkarzaRam or AcCedaH (ttiH).

To WRENCH , v. a. sAhasikAkuYcanaM or tIvrAkuYcanaM kftvA Akfz (c. 1. -karzati -karzwuM), balavadAkuYcanapUrvvam Akfzya apahf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), balavad Akfzya udDf, pIq (c. 10. pIqayati -yituM).
WRENCH , s. sAhasikAkuYcanapUrvvam AkarzaRaM or AkarzaH.
WREST: I To wrench: balAdAcCinatti.II To distort, writhe: q. v.
To WREST , v. a. valavad or sAhasena apahf. See To WRENCH.
Wrestle, v. i. mallayudDaM-bAhuyudDaM-kf 8 U, bAhU-bAhavi yuD 4 A. [Wrestl]er, s. mallaH, bAhuyoDaH-yin m. [Wrestl]ing, s. bAhu-malla-yudDaM, mallakrIqAyudDaM.
WRESTLE: (1) mallayudDaM karoti;(2) bAhuyudDaM karoti; (3) bAhUbAhavi yuDyate (yuD, c. 4.).
To WRESTLE , v. n. bAhuyudDaM kf, bAhupraharaRaM kf, mallayudDaM kf.
WRESTLER: (1) BallaH;(2) mallaH;(3) bAhuyoDaH.
WRESTLER , s. bAhuyoDI m. (n), bAhupraharttA m. (rttf), mallaH, JallaH, raNgA- vatArI m. (n); ‘king's wrestler,’ utmiktaH, udDataH.
WRESTLING (subs.): (1) mallayudDam;(2) bAhuyudDam; (3) mallakrIqA.
WRESTLING , s. bAhuyudDaM, mallayudDaM, mallakrIqA, mallayAtrA, mAllavI.

Wretch, s. durAtman m., durjAtaH, pApaH; pApizWaH, jAlmaH, hatASaH, narADamaH, caMqAlaH, KalaH. 2 maMda-hata-BAgyaH, varAkaH, aDanyaH, dInaH, tapasvin. [Wretch]ed, a. dIna, varAka (kI f.), aDanya; gen. ex. by hataka affixed, dagDa pr.; dagDodaraM, madanahatakaH &c.; hatASa; dur pr.; ‘w(retched) state’ durdaSA. 2 nikfzwatama, jaGanya. 3 duHKaBAj, atiduHKita. [Wretch]edly, adv. dInavat, dIna in comp.; ‘w(retchedly) dressed’ dInaveza; See Miserable.
WRETCH: I In bad sense: durAtman (mfn.): [Page769] v. Wicked.II A miserable person:(1) varAka (f. kI);(2) mandaBAgya (f. gyA): v. Unfortunate.
WRETCH , s. (Bad man) hatASaH, jAlmaH, pApaH, pApIyAn m. (s), pApizWaH, durAtmA m. (n), narADamaH, KalaH, caRqAlaH, lawwaH, laqqaH. — (Poor creature) mandaBAgyaH, tapasvI m. (n), hatASaH, kfpaRaH.
WRETCHED: I Miserable, pitiable: q. v.: (1) dIna (f. nA);(2) varAka (f. kI: only of persons: v. Poor).II Contemptible, low: q. v.: jaGanya (f. nyA).
WRETCHED , a. atiduHKI -KinI -Ki (n), atiduHKAnvitaH -tA -taM, atidInaH -nA -naM, dInaH &c., aDanyaH -nyA -nyaM. See MISERABLE.
WRETCHEDLY: expr. by adj. or comp., w. dressed: dInaveza or jaGanyaveza (f. zA).
WRETCHEDNESS: (1) dInatA: v. Misery;(2) jaGanyatA: v. Lowness.
Wriggle, v. t. itastataH cal c.
WRIGGLE: itastataScalati (cal, c. 1. = to move: when intrans.) or cAlayati (c. of cal: when trans.).
To WRIGGLE , v. n. deham itastataH kzipraM saMcal (c. 10. -cAlayati -yituM).

Wring, v. t. (balavat) AkuMc c., saM-pIq 10; ‘w(ring)ing his hands in grief’ duHKAt hastaM hastena nizpiMzan; ‘w(ring) off’ balAt nizkfz 1 P or nirhf 1 P; ‘w(ring) out’ nizpIqya grah 9 U, nizkfz, balavat niHsf c. or nirgam c.
WRING: I Lit.: AkuYcati (kuYc, c. 1.): v. Also to twist.II Fig., with out, off, etc.: nizpIqya bahizkarotiH v. Also to squeeze.

To WRING , v. a. (Twist or press violently) balavad or sAhasena AkuYc (c. 1. -kuYcati -YcituM, c. 10. kuYcayati -yituM) or pIq (c. 10. pIqayati -yituM) or samyIq. — (Wring off) balavadAkuYcanaM kftvA or balavad Akfzya udDf or nirhf or utkfz. — (Wring out water, &c.) balavat pIqayitvA jalaM nirgam in caus. or niHsf in caus.
Wrinkle, s. vali-lI f., BaMgaH, re(le)KA, carmaleKA-BaMgaH, carmasaMkocaH. v. t. carma-tvacaM-saMkuc 1 P or saM-hf 1 P. a. valiBa-na, valImat. [Wrinkl]ed, [Wrinkl]y, a. reKAMkita, BaMgavat.
WRINKLE: I Subs.: baliH (lI), the body filled with w. s.: balIsaNgatagAtra (f. trI), Mah. i. 82. 6.; three w. s: balitrayam, Ku. i. 32.II Verb: expr. by subs.

WRINKLE , s. baliH -lI f., carmmareKA, tvagreKA, reKA, carmmaleKA, carmma- taraNgaH, taraNgaH, UrmmiH m. f., UrmmikA, tvagUrmmiH m. f., BaNgaH, carmmaBaNgaH, tvakSETilyaM, tvaksaNkocaH, carmmasaNkocaH; ‘on the brow,’ lalAwareKA, lalAwaleKA.
To WRINKLE , v. a. tvacaM or carmma saMkuc (c. 1. -kocati -cituM) or kuYc (c. 1. kuYcati -YcituM) or AkuYc. See To CONTRACT.
WRINKLED: (1) balitaH (tA, taM), eyes with w. edges: balitApANgalocanaH, Ki. xi. 4.;(2) balimat (f. tI);(3) baliBaH (BA, BaM).
WRINKLED , WRINKLY, a. balinaH -nA -naM, balimAn -matI -mat (t), baliBaH -BA -BaM, UrmmimAn &c., reKANkitaH -tA -taM, sareKaH -KA -KaM.
Wrist, s. maRibaMDaH-DanaM, prakozWaH.
WRIST: maRibanDaH, -nam.
WRIST , s. maRivanDaH -nDanaM, kalyuzaM, prakozWaH, pravezwaH, colakI m. (n), maRiH m. f.
WRIT: (1) SAsanam;(2) leKaH (= writing).
WRIT , s. leKaH, leKyaM, leKapatraM; ‘Holy writ,’ SrutiH f., SrutaM.

sanskrit.slp1: asmAkaM cetasi kiM nAma na liKitamasti
sanskrit.word: अस्माकं चेतसि किं नाम न लिखितमस्ति
sanskrit.iast: asmākaṃ cetasi kiṃ nāma na likhitamasti

details.body: Write, v. t. liK 6 P; (in all senses), patre Aruh c. or ni-viS c. 2 praRI 1 P, rac 10, graMT 9 P, nirmA 3 A, 2 P, ni-pra-baMD 9 P. [Writ]er, s. leKakaH, lipikAraH, liK in comp. 2 praRetf m., graMTakft-kAraH, racakaH, nirmAtf m. [Writ]ing, s. leKaH, leKyaM, liKitaM, patraM, leKyapatraM; ‘committed to w(riting)’ patrArUQa, leKyArpita, patre niveSita. 2 (‘Art of w(riting)’) lipi-bi f., li(le)KanaM. 3 racanA, nirmARaM, praRayanaM. 4 akzarasaMsTAnaM-racanAvinyAsaH.

WRITE: liKati (liK, c. 6.), to w. with one's own hand: svahastena liKati, Y. ii. 89.; I saw this couplet written on it: tasyAmimAmamiliKitAmAryA- mapaSyam, K.; he has written this back: idamanena pratiliKitam, Mal. i.; getting a letter written by Śakaṭadāsa in these words: eBirakzarErleKaM Sakawa- dAsena leKayitvA, Mu. i.; what is not written on our minds: asmAkaM cetasi kiM nAma na liKitamasti, Ana. vii.: v. Also to compose.

To WRITE , v. a. or n. (With a pen) liK (c. 6. liKati, leKituM), aBiliK, leKanaM kf, liKataM kf, lipiM kf; ‘to write down,’ aBiliK, leKyArUQaM -QAM kf, patrArUQaM -QAM kf. — (Compose) granT (c. 9. graTnAti, c. 1. granTati -nTituM), granTanaM kf, rac (c. 10. racayati -yituM), kxp (c. 10. kalpayati -yituM), nibanD.
WRITER: I Lit.: leKakaH, be the w. of this Bhārata: leKako BAratasyAsya Bava, Mah. 77.II Author: q. v.: praRetf (f. trI).III A scribe: (1) lipikaraH;(2) leKakaH.
WRITER , s. (One who writes) leKakaH, lik in comp. (K), li- pikaraH, leKanakArI m. (n), livikaraH. — (Clerk) kAyasTaH, see SCRIBE. — (Composer) granTakAraH, granTakarttA m. (rttf), racakaH.
Writhe, v. i. (duHKAt) saMkuc 1 P (limbs &c.) or Akfz 1 P; See Smart.
WRITHE: I To shrink: q. v.: saMkucati (kuc, c. 6.).II To distort: AkuYcayati (c. of kuYc).
To WRITHE , v. a. or n. tIvravedanopahatatvAd aNgAni itastataH saMcal (c. 10. -cAlayati -yituM) or Akfz or aNgAkuYcanaM kf.
WRITHING , s. aNgAkuYcanaM, aNgAkarzaH, itastato'NgasaYcAlanaM.

WRITING (subs.): I The art of w.:(1) lipiH, ignorant of w.: alipijYaH, N. s.;(2) leKaH (KA);(3) le (li) Katam.II Anything written:(1) leKaH, looking at the w.: leKamavalokayan, Mu. v.;(2) leKyam (= docu- -ment);(3) liKitam.III Hand-w:(1) leKaH (KA);(2) liKitam, Mu. v.IV Composition:(1) leKaH (f. KA); li(le)Kanam; (3) liKitam.

WRITING , s. (The act) leKanaM, liKanaM, leKaH -KA, aBileKanaM, li- piH f., lipikA, liviH -vI f. — (Composition) racanA, granTanaM, granTakaraRaM. — (Written letters or characters) akzaravinyAsaH, akzararacanA. — (Any thing written) liKitaM, leKaH, leKyaM, leKya- patraM, patraM -trakaM; ‘committed to writing,’ leKyArUQaH -QA -QaM, patrArUQaH &c.; ‘writing materials,’ lipisajjA, leKasADanaM, leKanasAmagrI.
WRITING-MASTER , s. leKaSikzakaH, leKanaSikzakaH, leKopadeSakaH.
WRITING-PAPER , s. leKanapatraM, liKanapatraM, leKyapatraM.
WRITTEN , p. p. liKitaH -tA -taM, leKitaH &c.; ‘document,’ leKyaM

Wrong, a. anyAyya, aDarmya, nyAyavirudDa, ayaTAnyAya; oft. by ut-ku pr.; ‘w(rong) road’ vimArgaH, utpaTaH, kumArgaH. 2 ayukta, anu-cita, anupapanna, anarha. 3 BrAMta, miTyA, ayaTArTa, sadoza, vitaTa, asatya, anfta; ‘you are w(rong)’ miTyA-anftaM-BrAMtimUlakaM te vacaH; ‘this is not w(rong)’ nEza dozaH. s. anyAyaH, aDarmaH. 2 apakAraH, nikfti f., aparADaH. 3 BrAMti f., BramaH, ayATArTyaM, asatyatA. 4 dozaH; ‘in the w(rong)’ sadoza, BrAMta, BrAMtiyukta; ‘yourself are in the w(rong) here’ atra tavEva dozaH. v. t. ni-apa-kf, vi-pra-kf, aparAD 4 P; (with gen. or loc.). 2 miTyAdozaM nikzip 6 P or nyas 4 P; ‘w(rong)-doer’ aparADin, apakArakaH. [Wrong]ful, a. anyAyya, duzwa. [Wrong]fully, adv. anyAyataH, anyAyena. 2 duzwatayA. [Wrong]ly, adv. miTyA, ayuktaM, anyaTA, avitaTaM. 2 anyAyataH, ayaTAnyAyaM, anyAyena, aDarmeRa; BrAMtyA, &c.
WRONG (adj.): I Unjust: q. v.; anyAyya (f. yyA).II Improper: q. v.: ayukta (f. ktA).III Erroneous: q. v.: BrAnta (f. ntA). IV False: q. v.: miTyA.
WRONG (subs.): I Injury: q. v.: apakAraH. II Injustice: q. v.: anyAyaH.III Error: q. v.: BramaH.IV Fault: q. v.: dozaH.
WRONG (v.): I To injure: q. v.: apakaroti. II To find fault unjustly: miTyAdozaM vikzipati (kzip, c. 6.), nyasyati (as, c. 4.), etc.

WRONG , a. (Not fit or right) ayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, ayogyaH -gyA -gyaM, anupayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, anupapannaH -nnA -nnaM, see IMPROPER. — (Erroneous) ayaTArTaH -rTA -rTaM, anftaH -tA -taM, vitaTaH -TA -TaM, asatyaH &c., asamyaN -mIcI -myak (Yc), aSudDaH -dDA -dDaM, dozI -ziRI -zi (n), sadozaH -zA -zaM, aparADI &c., asan -satI -sat, see FALSE, IN- CORRECT. — (Unjust, acting improperly) anyAyyaH -yyA -yyaM, anyAyI -yinI &c., nyAyavirudDaH -dDA -dDaM, ayaTAnyAyaH -yA -yaM, see UNJUST. — (Reverse) viparItaH -tA -taM; ‘wrong road,’ unmArgaH, vimArgaH.

WRONG , s. (Injury, injustice) apakAraH, apakftaM, aparADaH, anyAyaH. — (Error) BramaH, BrAntiH f., dozaH, aparADaH, ayATArTyaM, ayuktaM, ayA- TAtaTyaM; ‘in the wrong,’ BrAnayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, BrAntiyuktaH &c., BramI -miRI &c., sadozaH -zA -zaM, dozI &c., aparADI &c.
WRONG , WRONGLY, adv. ayuktaM, anyaTA, ayaTAyuktaM, ayaTAyogyaM, aya- TArTaM, anyAyatas, ayaTAnyAyaM, vfTA, miTyA
To WRONG , v. a. apakf, anyAyaM kf, aparAD. See To INJURE.
WRONG-DOER (1) aparADin (f. nI = offender); (2) apakAraka (f. rikA = injurer);(3) utpIqaka (f. qikA = tormentor).
WRONGED , p. p. apakftaH -tA -taM, prAptApakAraH -rA -raM, kftApakAraH &c.
WRONGFUL (1) anyAya (f. yA): v. Unjust; (2) duzwa (f. zwA): v. Wicked.
WRONGFULLY: (1) anyAyataH: v. Unjustly; (2) duzwamAvenaH v. Wickedly.
WRONGLY: (1) BiTyA: v. Falsely;(2) ayuktam: v. Improperly;(3) anyAyataH: v. Unjustly.
WROTH: kupita (f. tA): v. Enraged.
WROTH , a. kopAvizwaH -zwA -zwaM, rozAvizwaH &c. See ANGRY.
WROUGHT: (1) kfta (f. tA);(2) saMskfta or upaskfta (f. tA). W. iron: kuSI.

WROUGHT , p. p. (Done) kftaH -tA -taM, see PERFORMED. — (Worked, elaborated) saMskftaH -tA -taM, saMskAritaH &c., kxptaH -ptA -ptaM, kalpitaH &c., sidDaH -dDA -dDaM; ‘wrought iron,’ kuSI; ‘wrought gold.’ kozaH, kftahemaM. — (Stirred) uttejitaH -tA -taM.
Wry, a. vakra. [Wry]ness, s. vakratA. 2 vikftaM, vikfti f.
WRY: (1) vakra (f. krA = crooked: q. v.), w- necked: vakragrIva (f. vA);(2) vikfta (f. tA = deformed: q. v.), w.-faced: vikftAnana (f. nA).
WRY , a. vakraH -krA -kraM, vikftaH -tA -taM; ‘wry-faced,’ vikftAnanaH &c.
WRY-NECKED , a. vakragrIvaH -vA -vaM, vikftagrIvaH &c., vakrakanDaraH &c.
WRYNESS , s. vakratA, vakrimA m. (n), vikftiH f., virUpatA, vErUpyaM.
